Join Apple, and help us leave the world better than we found it.  

  

**Description**  

As a Technical Program Manager you would be the technical lead for manufacturing operations at multiple vendors and sites.  

  

* Drive contract manufacturer preparation for pre\-production builds.
* Production process development, documentation, optimization and validation.
* Development and implementation of new technologies to improve production quality, capacity and efficiency.
* Set standard practices and independently settle impact to design approaches and parameters to the final product.
* Provide direction, mentorship and resources to other engineering groups and project leaders as well as factory technicians.
* Act as lead engineer on a variety of projects and participates in the project planning of major sub\-projects.

  

Perform assignments in several of the following manufacturing engineering functions:  

  

\- Design for Manufacturability \- Provide early and ongoing manufacturing involvement to ensure new products are mechanically manufacturable.  

* Product Engineering: Work all phases of a product from concept to repeat manufacturing to end of life. Provide production support engineering with respect to technically complex testing methods, procedures and failure analysis.
* Process Engineering: Design and develop technically complex processes to improve quality and efficiency.
* Failure/Data Analysis: Plan, develop and implement technically complex procedures for the testing and evaluation of soon to be released products.
* Specify tests to be performed, compile data and make recommendations for product design changes and final assembly standards. This will include the use of Design of Experiments (DOE) and statistical analysis using Six Sigma principles.

An IT systems engineer develops, tests, implements, and evaluates new software, improves existing processes, upgrades hardware, and does whatever else is necessary to ensure that the organization has streamlined and functional systems that can meet the KN business needs. You also ensure that problems are prevented or solved, should they happen.
  

As systems engineer, you understand technology beyond merely engineering it. You understand the role it plays in the larger picture of KN s and every employee s ultimate objective. Qualified systems engineers will have a background in IT, computer systems engineering, or systems engineering and \-analysis.

description:
Job Description – Program Manager

Company: Bijliride

Location: Madhapur, Hyderabad

Employment Type: Full\-Time

Experience: 2–6 Years

Qualification: MBA / PGDM Preferred

About Bijliride

Bijliride is a fast\-growing electric mobility company focused on building sustainable, affordable, and convenient mobility solutions through electric two\-wheeler rentals, B2B fleet solutions, 3PL services, battery swapping, and EV mobility solutions.

Position Overview

We are looking for a Program Manager who will be responsible for building and managing structured programs across business operations, franchise expansion, and cross\-functional teams.

The role will focus on team alignment, organizational matrices, SOPs and documentation, reporting systems, franchise reporting, and execution of franchise/business expansion projects.

The ideal candidate should be highly organized, analytical, proactive, and capable of working across multiple teams to ensure programs are executed effectively and business objectives are achieved.

Key Responsibilities

1\. Program \& Project Management

* Plan, execute, and monitor strategic business and operational programs.
* Manage end\-to\-end franchise projects, from planning and setup to execution and performance monitoring.
* Define project objectives, timelines, milestones, KPIs, and ownership.
* Track project progress and ensure timely completion of deliverables.
* Identify operational challenges and drive timely resolution.
* Coordinate multiple teams to ensure smooth project execution

2\. Franchise Management \& Expansion

* Support the development and execution of franchise expansion projects.
* Build structured processes for franchise onboarding, launch, operations, and performance tracking.
* Develop and maintain franchise reporting systems and dashboards.
* Track franchise\-wise KPIs, revenue, fleet performance, utilization, operational performance, and other business metrics.
* Coordinate with franchise partners and internal teams to ensure alignment.
* Identify gaps in franchise operations and drive corrective actions.
* Support new franchise launches and ensure readiness across operations, people, assets, and processes.

3\. Team Alignment \& Team Matrix

* Build and maintain team structures and responsibility matrices.
* Define roles, responsibilities, ownership, and reporting relationships across teams.
* Create RACI / team responsibility matrices wherever required.
* Ensure clear ownership of tasks and deliverables.
* Improve communication and alignment between Operations, Sales, Finance, HR, Technology, and other functions.
* Conduct regular follow\-ups to ensure teams remain aligned with program objectives.

4\. Reporting \& MIS

* Build and maintain team reporting systems and performance dashboards.
* Establish standardized reporting formats across departments.
* Track team\-wise and function\-wise KPIs.
* Prepare weekly and monthly management reports.
* Consolidate operational and business data for leadership review.
* Identify trends, gaps, and performance issues through data analysis.
* Ensure reports are accurate, timely, and actionable.

5\. SOPs, Policies \& Documentation

* Create, standardize, and maintain SOPs, process documents, checklists, and operational guidelines.
* Document workflows and ensure processes are clearly defined.
* Work with functional teams to identify process gaps and improve existing SOPs.
* Ensure teams understand and follow documented processes.
* Maintain proper documentation for new programs, projects, and franchise operations.
* Regularly review and update SOPs based on operational requirements.

6\. Process Improvement

* Identify inefficiencies across existing processes and recommend improvements.
* Develop systems and frameworks to improve operational efficiency.
* Standardize processes across teams and franchise locations.
* Monitor implementation and measure the impact of process improvements.
* Drive accountability through clear KPIs, ownership, and reporting mechanisms.

7\. Cross\-Functional Coordination

* Act as a central point of coordination between different business functions.
* Work closely with Operations, Sales, Finance, HR, Technology, Marketing, and leadership teams.
* Ensure dependencies between teams are identified and managed.
* Follow up on action items and ensure timely closure.
* Escalate critical issues to leadership with clear analysis and recommended solutions.

Candidate Requirements

* MBA / PGDM preferred.
* 2–6 years of experience in Program Management, Project Management, Business Operations, Management Consulting, Business Strategy, or a similar role.
* Strong understanding of project planning, execution, and tracking.
* Experience in building MIS, dashboards, reporting structures, and performance matrices.
* Strong documentation and SOP creation skills.
* Excellent Excel / Google Sheets skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to coordinate with multiple teams and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Strong ownership and follow\-through.
* Experience in franchise operations, business expansion, EV, mobility, logistics, or similar industries will be an advantage.

Key Skills

* Program \& Project Management
* Franchise Operations \& Expansion
* SOP \& Process Documentation
* Team Matrix \& RACI
* MIS \& Reporting
* Dashboard Management
* KPI Tracking
* Cross\-Functional Coordination
* Process Improvement
* Business Analysis
* Stakeholder Management
* Excel / Google Sheets

What We Offer

* Opportunity to work closely with the leadership team.
* Exposure to business expansion and franchise operations.
* Hands\-on experience in building systems, processes, and reporting frameworks.
* Opportunity to work in the growing EV and electric mobility industry.
* Career growth and leadership exposure.
* Fast\-paced and dynamic work environment.

Immediate joiners are preferred.

Pay: ₹300,000\.00 \- ₹700,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Madhapur, Hyderabad, Telangana: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Preferred)

Application Question(s):

* Current \\ Last salary
* Expected salary

**Job descriptions may display in multiple languages****based on your language selection.**

**What we offer:**
------------------


At Magna, you can expect an engaging and dynamic environment where you can help to develop industry\-leading automotive technologies. We invest in our employees, providing them with the support and resources they need to succeed. As a member of our global team, you can expect exciting, varied responsibilities as well as a wide range of development prospects. Because we believe that your career path should be as unique as you are.**Group Summary:**
------------------


Transforming mobility. Making automotive technology that is smarter, cleaner, safer and lighter. That’s what we’re passionate about at Magna Powertrain, and we do it by creating world\-class powertrain systems. We are a premier supplier for the global automotive industry with full capabilities in design, development, testing and manufacturing of complex powertrain systems. Our name stands for quality, environmental consciousness, and safety. Innovation is what drives us and we drive innovation. Dream big and create the future of mobility at Magna Powertrain.**Job Responsibilities:**

**Job title:**


Specialist Project Management

**Job Introduction**

* Support EPI to Identify the project’s needs and ensure execution of engineering project to achieve defined targets (T/C/Q) at the overall Engineering project level.
* Lead the assigned Engineering project team and promote positive project culture (facilitates a professional collaboration).
* Promote process adherence and continuous improvement (reviews, lessons learned, ...)
* Align with EPI on project specific strategic topics and customer communication.
* Support Acquisition and manage eQuote Phase in close cooperation with eProject Team, Sales, Program Management and responsible line management per engineering quote process.
* Ensure nomination of an efficient and successful engineering project team of assigned Sub\-Project
* Preparation and support EPI of execution of GPMS Phase Reviews and participation in GPMS Gate Review meetings
* Participate in internal audit and external audit in the context of Engineering Quality
* Must have knowledge of ASPICE process
* Sound knowledge of Project Execution Process, Product Development process and ASPICE compliant gate reviews
* Establish and maintain an eProject time schedule for sub\-projects based on master timing. Identify critical path and address corresponding risk. Communicate any changes or delays to EPI / Master timing.
* Coordinate Engineering sub\-project team, perform the activities of the project in accordance with the eProject Plan, identify deviations from the eProject Plan, lead countermeasure activities and escalate according to defined escalation procedure.
* Coordinate risk identification and risk evaluation/analysis as well as countermeasure definition, planning, and execution for assigned sub\-project. Regular monitoring and reporting of identified risk items.
* Perform project marketing (achieve satisfaction with / acceptance of project results at project sponsor, customer, and project team)
* Interface of Sub\-project team to EPI and first level contact to program and customer for engineering relevant sub\-project related topics (according to project specific communication agreement)
* Ensuring resource planning using suitable measures and methods
* Ensure project controlling for assigned Sub\-project in terms of actuals vs. budget on a regular basis to identify deviations, avoid their occurrence and support claim management.
* Support to Ensure efficient closure of the series development project and transfer of necessary activities to serial production support

**Major Responsibilities:**

* Breakdown of the objectives of the sub\-project to relevant work package
* Prioritize in terms of content, timing and budget within approved sub\-project framework
* Delegate work to assigned project members to ensure project milestones and quality objectives are met
* Reject assignment of team members if they are not skilled properly
* Decide on counter measures to get sub\-project back on track within approved project framework (budget, timing, quality)
* Escalate project deviations to EPI and management in accordance of escalation plan
* Shift of Budget within Request additional budget in case of project deviations
* Approval of work products acc. process definition
* Participate in Quality audits and task force

**Knowledge and Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical/ Electronics/ Software)
* Preferred if PMP or MBA

 **Work Experience:**

  

5\-8 years of relevant professional experience in the automotive industry as a project management professionals

**Awareness, Unity, Empowerment:**
----------------------------------


At Magna, we believe that a diverse workforce is critical to our success. That’s why we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We hire on the basis of experience and qualifications, and in consideration of job requirements, regardless of, in particular, color, ancestry, religion, gender, origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or gender identity. Magna takes the privacy of your personal information seriously. We discourage you from sending applications via email or traditional mail to comply with GDPR requirements and your local Data Privacy Law.

**AI\-Assisted Screening Disclosure**
-------------------------------------


As part of our commitment to a fair, consistent, and efficient recruitment process, we may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in the initial screening of applications submitted through our Workday system. These tools help identify qualifications and experience that align with the role requirements. Please note that AI is used solely to support our recruiters. Final decisions are always made by the hiring manager and the hiring team. Importantly, no applicant data is shared externally through these AI tools. All information remains securely within our systems and is handled in accordance with our privacy and data protection policies.

**Under conditions defined by applicable law, you may have the right to request an explanation of how AI is used to support decision\-making.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


If you have any questions or concerns about this process, feel free to contact our Talent Attraction team.

***Purpose of the role in 1\-2 sentences***


This role is responsible for planning, organizing, and managing resources to ensure that projects are completed on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards. Construction Project Engineers work closely with architects, contractors, and other stakeholders to ensure that projects are executed according to plan.


Post\-construction – Techno commercial closure including measurements and billing


**Job Description**

***3\-5 bullet points of specific duties***

**About the Role:**

* Monitor progress of work with respect to Master project schedule
* Monitoring the execution of work at site to ensure alignment to the drawings and specification.
* Timely reminders to all contractors about the delays in schedule
* Ensuring the workability and adherence to standards in the work statement/methodologies submitted by contractors for each item of work and ensuring the alignment to the same at site. Responsible for all site work related documentation for the assigned items of work.
* Anticipate and flag imminent bottlenecks. Take steps to avoid delays. Furnish necessary reports of critical activities and super critical activities to client.
* Advice contractors in enhancing the resource productivity by implementing various work study techniques.
* Monitor procurement of materials, equipment and labour by contractors with respect to the time schedule and advise them suitable measures for improvement.
* Manage the billing on site

***3\-5 bullet points of key selection criteria***

**About You:**

* B.E Civil. / Electrical / Mechanical / Architect (Fresher or 0\-6 years exp).
* Technical awareness of civil, electro\-mechanical, and architectural works
* Excellent organizational and motivational skills
* Outstanding attention to detail and observation ability
* Exceptional communication and interpersonal abilities

***3 bullet points of job/country specific benefits***

As one of the leading global real estate services firms transforming the way people work, shop and live working at Cushman \& Wakefield means you will benefit from;

* Being part of a growing global company;

We're committed to providing work\-life balance for our people in an inclusive, rewarding environment.

description:
Job Description – Project Manager

**Company: Sandeep Shikre \& Associates (SSA Architect)**

**Position:** Project Manager  
**Experience:** 16\+ Years  
**Qualification:** B.Arch  
**Location:** 203/204, Prabhadevi Industrial Estate, Veer Savarkar Marg, Prabhadevi, Mumbai – 400 025  
**Working Hours:** Monday to Saturday \| 10:00 AM to 6:45 PM  
**Weekly Off:** 2nd \& 4th Saturday

Key Responsibilities

* Maintain and deliver high\-quality architectural and interior design services to clients while ensuring projects comply with SSA’s Quality Assurance, CAD standards, and procedures.
* Develop approved project work plans and ensure their effective implementation throughout the project lifecycle.
* Review the scope of work for all stakeholders and ensure that work is performed to the required quality and standards.
* Assist the Principal / Associate Principal by compiling project information and monitoring compliance with contract requirements, quality standards, project schedules, and deliverables.
* Assist in training team members, evaluating their performance, and identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and quality.
* Allocate project resources and regularly monitor budgeted project hours. Identify resource over\-allocation and implement corrective measures as required.
* Represent SSA in communications and coordination with clients, subconsultants, and contractors throughout the project and post\-agreement activities.
* Maintain proper records of project meetings, discussions, decisions, and follow\-up actions.
* Review project status with the Principal / Associate Principal, including design changes, anticipated contract alterations, additional service requests, and other factors affecting project resources, timelines, and costs.
* Monitor project budgets and ensure that projects are executed within the approved budgeted cost.
* Monitor engineering contracts, subcontracts, change orders, additional services, and other agreements to ensure compliance with established internal procedures.
* Coordinate with subconsultants to ensure compliance with design intent, applicable codes, discipline standards, quality requirements, and project schedules.
* Ensure that subconsultant deliverables are completed accurately, as per discipline standards, and within agreed timelines.
* Coordinate with contractors regarding timely review and response to RFIs, shop drawings, material approvals, and site\-related issues.
* Review tender documents, including drawings, specifications, BOQs, and reports, and ensure that construction documents are aligned with project specifications and BOQs.
* Assist in preparing and reviewing construction documents to ensure they accurately reflect the construction scope and design intent.
* Coordinate building code reviews and conduct document reviews with clients, contractors, vendors, and other project stakeholders.
* Review and validate the scope of services to be provided by subconsultants.
* Assist with Construction Administration activities, including project team meetings, construction meetings, site observations, monitoring proposed changes, and coordination with the project team and client.
* Monitor construction progress to ensure design intent, quality standards, and client expectations are maintained.
* Assist with snag\-list preparation, substantial completion, project close\-out, and completion of record drawings.
* Audit the project Folder Management System regularly and ensure proper documentation and organization.
* Review and approve team members’ timesheets on a weekly basis.
* Supervise and mentor interns and junior team members as assigned.
* Effectively manage project **billing, resources, team productivity, punctuality, client coordination, invoices, contracts, additional services, reports, and project documentation**.
* Ensure proper coordination with clients, subconsultants, and contractors regarding project scope, quality, deliverables, schedules, RFIs, site issues, material approvals, and overall project requirements.
* Continuously develop professional and technical capabilities through industry involvement, professional organizations, training, education, new skills, and innovative practices.

Pay: ₹150,000\.00 \- ₹220,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

description:
**About Us**




 Exotel is the emerging market’s leading full\-stack customer engagement platform and business\-focused virtual telecom operator. Founded in 2011, our cloud\-based product suite powers over 50 million daily engagements across voice, video, and messaging channels.
 



 Trusted by 6,000\+ companies across 60\+ countries—including India, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and Africa—Exotel enables unified customer engagement for leading businesses such as Ola, Swiggy, Flipkart, GoJek, Byju’s, HDFC Bank, Zomato, and Urban Company. Our offerings include communication APIs, a modern omnichannel contact centre, and a conversational AI platform hosted on the cloud. We are a Series D company valued at $100 million with $60 million in ARR.
 



  





**About the Pod**




 This role sits directly within our product pod, managing the end\-to\-end technical delivery of Conversational Quality Assurance (CQA) products. Unlike broader corporate delivery tracks, this position has direct ownership of enterprise implementations from initiation to completion, serving as the bridge between cutting\-edge AI product performance and enterprise execution.
 



  





**About the Role**




 We are seeking an Technical Project Manager to fully own the end\-to\-end execution, delivery processes, and client communication for our CQA product line. In this role, you will step into a key leadership position within the pod, managing all technical communication with incoming enterprise customers, translating their expectations into functional workflows, and driving internal execution.
 



 As the delivery lead, you will have direct ownership of the project lifecycle. You will balance high\-stakes stakeholder management with a deep technical understanding of cloud telecom ecosystems and frontier AI.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities**




**1\. Delivery Ownership \& Team Leadership** 



* Take absolute end\-to\-end ownership of the CQA product delivery process, relieving leadership from daily execution tasks.
* Establish, optimize, and enforce robust project management processes tailored for large, complex enterprise clients.



**2\. Client \& Technical Stakeholder Management** 



* Act as the primary, front\-facing technical interface for onboarding enterprise clients.
* Lead client discover sessions to extract, understand, and document technical requirements from a product standpoint.
* Drive alignment and manage timelines across multiple external and internal stakeholders, ensuring projects move forward without bottlenecks.



**3\. Technical Project Execution** 



* Oversee the complex integration of CQA products into Exotel’s existing telecom/API ecosystem.
* Ensure smooth deployment and operational validation of frontier GenAI and LLM applications within the clients' environments.
* Coordinate daily with engineering, pre\-sales, and delivery teams, facilitating a seamless post\-delivery handover to Support Engineers.



  





**What We’re Looking For**




**Experience \& Core Competencies** 



* 5 to 8 years of solid project management experience, explicitly within software, SaaS, or deep technical product delivery.
* Proven track record of managing and delivery implementations for large enterprise customers.



**Technical Skillset** 



* AI \& Frontier Tech: Strong familiarity with AI/ML, NLP, conversational AI concepts, and hands\-on exposure to GenAI (prompt engineering, LLM applications).
* Integrations \& Infrastructure: Deep understanding of integration methods for CRMs, APIs, cloud systems, architecture, and deployment methodologies.
* Systems Knowledge: Comfortable understanding what works and what doesn't across Linux, networking, databases, message queues, and caching.



**Soft Skills \& Process Drive** 



* Exceptional communication and negotiation skills—capable of driving technical discussions with enterprise executives and internal engineers alike.
* High level of accountability, organizational rigor, and time management.
* A proactive, customer\-focused approach to problem\-solving and risk mitigation.

**Organization Overview**
**Company Description**
**About QAD Redzone**
 Redzone helps manufacturers make more stuff for less while greatly improving the employee experience. While there is a lot of hype around digital transformation, the factory of the future, and Industry 4\.0, the focus has been on the equipment and technology – not the people. At Redzone, we are all about the people, what we call “the connected worker.” We make frontline teams more engaged and more productive so their lives improve while contributing to positive business outcomes. We do this by combining exceptional software and world class coaching, giving our customers an average productivity increase of 22% in 90 days. Redzone brings together Production, Maintenance and Quality teams, improving the communications between those teams to resolve issues and increase output. Decision making happens on the shop floor by the people doing the work, in real time, for immediate impact and a better overall employee experience.
   

  

 With over 1000 customers, 1200 plants and 325,000 users, Redzone is changing the way people work – one plant at a time.
   

  

 Founded in 2013 with a bold vision to transform manufacturing performance, while bringing dignity back to the frontline worker. Redzone provides the tools that enable the self\-organizing adaptive behavior of the front\-line manufacturing team to win the productivity game, avoiding downtime, or quality losses.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Under the leadership of Coaching Director, the Project Manager is responsible for management and oversight of Redzone’s project implementation.
   

  

 This position is Full Time, Remote and required to travel 40% of the time.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Facilitate and lead the customer journey for 6\-12 weeks after each new customer is added until we go onsite to coach.
* Participate in onsite Success Plan to focus the customer on the priority activities that need completion.
* Ensure signals are connected and tested prior to onsite coaching.
* Support the infrastructure and installation for Visual Factory.
* Guide the customer and provide support configuration to map Redzone to the customer’s site.
* Highlight any risks and address them with the customer team, Coaching Director, and Platform Leadership.
* Responsible for overseeing the deployment of Redzone software for multiple concurrent clients\- manage the process from the handover from the sales team through providing onsite coaching services.
* Configure and setup Redzone software that matches the production process at the client’s manufacturing plant. This process must include manufacturing data such as product and equipment information and product run rates.
* Ensure automation signals from the plant (such as photo eyes or machine cycles) come back to the software and provide accurate and real time data to Redzone for the shop floor team.
* Ensure the contractor work with the hardware and automation happens quickly and efficiently while maintaining the project schedule and cost plan.
* Perform regular weekly status calls with active project teams across multiple clients in order to ensure project stays on track and all milestones are achieved.
* Responsible for the success of the software and coaching a “Green Go Live” based on project management leading up to that point.
* Manage client relationships and satisfaction, including but not limited to serving as the point of contact for projects, responding to client requests, and critical events in a professional and timely manner.
* Understand the escalation process for any critical path items or risk points that could result in delays or unsatisfactory project result(s).
* Document and maintain the project templates, training decks, and communication tools that are used with clients.
* Support on\-site Continuous Improvement Coaches and customers with configuration, expansion, and automation requests.
* Other duties as assigned.


**Qualifications**
**Required Skills**
* Understand the shop floor environment, workflow, and processes in Food \& Beverage and Consumer Packaged Goods’ for a variety of industries with the necessary depth to foster confidence and to support the client during the project.
* Sound judgement and excellent assessment skills.
* Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills.
* Understand escalation process for any critical path items or risk points that could cause a delay or unsatisfactory project result.
* Experience working with project management, ideally in software or systems deployments.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Experience managing or supporting software projects of different sizes, complexity and contractual types.
* Proven ability to cut through barriers to accomplish tasks.
* Confident with MS Office Suite, Windows operating systems and Apple hardware/operating systems.
* Ability to plan, organize, and function effectively in a dynamic environment, addressing multiple demands of internal teams and clients. Manage multiple deadlines and tasks.
* Ability to develop and maintain strong relationships with clients as well as internal teams.
* Ability to self\-manage and prioritize tasks across active projects to meet critical path deadlines.
* Able to work in a high paced, high growth environment.
* Tech friendly \& comfortable communicating technical requirements regarding networking, wireless, and software information.
* Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) experience and familiarity is a plus, but not required


**Education/Experience**
* BA or BS – Relevant fields of study can include and are not limited to: Engineering, Manufacturing, Organizational Leadership/Management, Supply Chain Management, Business Management.
* 4\+ years in a similar position\-providing direct coaching to business clients.


**Additional Information**
* Your health and well being are important to us at QAD. We provide programs that help you strike a healthy work\-life balance.
* Opportunity to join a growing business, launching into its next phase of expansion and transformation.
* Collaborative culture of smart and hard\-working people who support one another to get the job done.
* An atmosphere of growth and opportunity, where idea\-sharing is always prioritized over level or Hierarchy.
* Compensation packages based on experience and desired skill set


**About QAD And QAD Redzone**
 QAD Inc. is a leading provider of adaptive, cloud\-based enterprise software and services for global manufacturing companies. Global manufacturers face ever\-increasing disruption caused by technology\-driven innovation and changing consumer preferences. In order to survive and thrive, manufacturers must be able to innovate and change business models at unprecedented rates of speed. QAD calls these companies Adaptive Manufacturing Enterprises.
   

  

 QAD Redzone helps to enable QAD’s vision for the Adaptive Enterprise. Labor productivity improvements directly impact efficiency. Productive and empowered employees increase the effective capacity of your plant and accelerate time to productivity for new employees giving manufacturers the agility to increase production beyond what was previously possible without having to invest in production equipment or new plants, and reduce the amount and impact of employee attrition. Empowered employees with a growth mindset take extreme ownership of challenges that impact their production goals, creating resilience in the face of disruption.
   

  

 We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class.

description:
**Lead Complex Valve Projects as Assistant Manager – Project Execution**
========================================================================

Are you ready for the next step in your career? Join us as a Senior Engineer / Assistant Manager – Project Execution and play a key role in delivering valve and spare part orders that keep customer operations moving forward. You will review and execute customer contracts, coordinate with suppliers and customers, and drive projects from order receipt to final delivery. In this role, your expertise will help ensure quality, timely execution, and customer satisfaction while working closely with cross\-functional teams. If you enjoy combining engineering knowledge with project management and customer interaction, this could be your next challenge.


**Your responsibilities**
-------------------------

* You will review customer orders against quotations and contractual requirements, ensuring all project, product, and legal requirements are accurately captured.
* You will manage order execution activities, maintain project data in CRM and ERP systems, and ensure customer commitments are met throughout the project lifecycle.
* You will coordinate with customers, suppliers, sales teams, and third\-party inspectors to secure document approvals, inspections, and timely order progress.
* You will monitor project schedules, provide regular progress updates to customers and internal stakeholders, and support shipping and inspection clearances.
* You will collaborate with finance, sales, and customers to facilitate documentation and support on\-time payment collection while maintaining high quality standards.

**Expectations for you**
------------------------

* You hold a B.E. / B.Tech degree, preferably in Mechanical Engineering.
* You have 8\+ years of experience in project management within industrial products, particularly valves.
* You possess knowledge of control valve and actuator sizing and selection, with familiarity in valve applications and ASME codes being advantageous.
* You are proficient in MS Office applications, especially Excel, and have experience working with ERP systems.
* You have strong written and verbal English communication skills along with excellent organizational skills and the ability to manage changing priorities.

**To succeed in this role**
---------------------------

Success in this position requires strong project execution expertise, a solid understanding of valve products and customer contract requirements, and the ability to coordinate effectively across customers, suppliers, inspectors, sales, and finance teams. You should be highly organized, quality\-focused, and capable of managing multiple priorities while ensuring customer commitments are delivered on time.


We also expect you to align with Valmet’s Leadership Principles—practical behaviours that guide how we lead, collaborate, and succeed together:


* Take accountability – Act with ownership, set clear expectations, and follow through
* Lead with courage – Champion change, try bold ideas, and learn quickly
* Build on trust – Listen to understand, be open, and create psychological safety
* Collaborate for growth – Work across boundaries, value diverse perspectives, and focus on customer value

**We offer**
------------

You will become part of the Project Execution function responsible for reviewing, processing, and executing customer orders for valves and spare parts. The team works closely with customers, suppliers, sales, finance, and inspection agencies to ensure projects are delivered with high quality and on schedule. You will have the opportunity to contribute to customer satisfaction, operational excellence, and continuous improvement initiatives while working on technically challenging projects. The role offers broad exposure to project management, engineering practices, customer interactions, and supply chain coordination.


Valmet offers an inspiring and challenging position with opportunities for professional growth and development. Our collaborative and international work environment encourages innovation, continuous learning, and knowledge sharing. We value our employees and provide modern tools, development opportunities, and a supportive workplace culture.


**Want to know more?**
----------------------

Did we catch your interest? We would love to hear from you. For further information about this opportunity, please contact the Hiring Manager or the Talent Acquisition team. Please submit your application through our careers portal before the application closing date specified in the job posting.


**When everything works together**
----------------------------------

*Valmet is where the best talent from a wide variety of backgrounds comes together. We work together with our customers throughout the entire lifecycle, delivering cutting\-edge technologies and services as well as mission\-critical automation and flow control solutions. Backed by more than 225 years of industrial experience and a global team of over 19,000 professionals close to customers, we are uniquely positioned to transform industries toward a regenerative tomorrow. At Valmet, diversity of thought drives innovation. We are committed to a respectful and inclusive environment, where people can be themselves and are supported to contribute at their best. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and make hiring decisions based on skills, experience, and potential, never on personal characteristics such as gender, gender identity, age, ethnicity, nationality, disability, neurodiversity, religion, sexual orientation, or political views. Join the team – and lead the way with us!*

description:
**About us**


As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers. Joining Target means promoting a culture of mutual care and respect and striving to make the most meaningful and positive impact. Becoming a Target team member means joining a community that values different voices and lifts each other up. Here, we believe your unique perspective is important, and you'll build relationships by being authentic and respectful.

**Overview about Target In India**  

  

At Target, we have a timeless purpose and a proven strategy. And that hasn’t happened by accident. Some of the best minds from different backgrounds come together at Target to redefine retail in an inclusive learning environment that values people and delivers world\-class outcomes. That winning formula is especially apparent in Bengaluru, where Target in India operates as a fully integrated part of Target’s global team and has more than 4,000 team members supporting the company’s global strategy and operations.

**Pyramid Overview**


Fueling the continued success of one of the world’s most beloved and recognized brands is a distinctly capable, creative and innovative Marketing organization. Target Marketing is well known for inspiring and surprising guests, and we pride ourselves on connecting them to the design, products and experiences they expect and deserve from Target. We study our guests to discover new needs and insights, and then craft every interaction to build brand love. We are market experts who insist on a clear and cohesive understanding of our guests, guest segments and behaviors, business objectives, strategies and tactics, overcoming obstacles and measuring success. Our commitment to partnering both internally and with external agencies gives us a wide range of capabilities, from award\-winning creative work to exciting and unique promotional marketing. Leveraging our collective assets and fostering a healthy, supportive and open team culture, we deliver a holistically gratifying experience that guests can only get at Target.


Target in India Marketing delivers differentiating yet relevant marketing communication solutions across channels operating as an integrated ONE global team and it strives to bring excellence every time in how they create, connect and collaborate.


A role with **Target in India Marketing** is an opportunity to work with some of the best in the business for marketing, creative, strategy \& digital and you’d lead/contribute to work that connects to millions of guests. Your influence will drive sales and grow brand love through work that’s guest\-centric, on brand, category relevant and channel focused.

**Target Creative’s Brand Design Lab** is the in\-house creative/design team dedicated to bringing some of the world’s most beloved and recognizable owned brands to life. Our mission is to inspire a sense of joy, wonder and excitement, and to take our guests—and ourselves—somewhere new. Some of the brands we have built are Good \& Gather, Favorite Day, Ever Spring, Hearth \& Hand, Cat \& Jack, Goodfellow \& Co. Operating as one fully integrated team in both the U.S. and India, the team comprises the best and brightest talent to execute market\-leading creative strategy, packaging design \& brand building.


As a Sr. Project Management Analyst, Marketing, Brand Design Lab you will operate at the intersection of your creative team and the business. At the core you are expected to lead projects at category level or deliver to business objectives working alongside with your team.


You will be helping further Target’s strategies in playing a key role with great execution. You will be performing your role with minimal direction. You are expected to have a very good understanding of your functional area and design “how” creative work is accomplished by planning, organizing, managing and executing project plans/processes in addition to serving as the single point of contact \& relationship manager for cross\-functional teams (CFT).


As a Sr. Project Management Analyst, Marketing, Brand Design Lab you will:

* Project manage packaging design projects throughout the creative strategy\- execution lifecycle. Act as the single\-point\-of\-contact between Target HQ partners, Creative team \& Target in India CFT teams (*copywriters, photographers, illustrators, art directors, production designers and creative managers)* and lead projects through the entire concept \& activation phase
* Having a developed sense of design, a strong understanding of Brand Building, Packaging Design, and Design systems. Being meticulous and have an excellent eye for detail and brand consistency. Understanding /awareness of the global culture. Keeps abreast of current design trends
* Excellent ability to communicate design thinking and effective presentation skills. Communicate design strategy to various audiences in a strategic manner
* Lead creative project management process optimization, documentation of processes, standards, and guidelines. Organize and plan details for multiple projects and make timely and quick decisions to meet project deadlines
* Create and maintain appropriate documentation, prepare and share status reports / dashboards to appropriate stakeholders at set intervals
* The ability to see projects through from inception to production. Having strong printing and prepress knowledge
* Plan and conduct design research
* Lead /assist with special projects which could either be self\-identified or assigned

**About you:**

* Ability to manage and execute multiple projects at the same time
* Exceptional communication skills across all settings, ability to tailor message as appropriate
* Resourceful and able to work independently on filling in gaps of information
* Able to demonstrate flexibility in approach and adapt to changing priorities and requirements
* Has curiosity and drive for seeking and promoting new ideas, in combination with solid business judgment

description:
Avance Clinical is a Contract Research Organisation which offers specialised services supporting drug development for the pharmaceutical and biotechnology industry.
   

  

 The Project Manager \- EPMO will be responsible for managing the planning and execution of internal projects assigned within Avance Clinical's Enterprise Project Management Office (EPMO). Operating within the EPMO's tiered governance model, the Project Manager will be allocated projects from Tier 1 (Explore), Tier 2 (Build), or Tier 3 (Transform) relative to their experience, certifications and demonstrated delivery capability — scaling responsibility as they grow within the function. The role applies established project management principles to ensure consistent, disciplined delivery across the portfolio, and contributes to the EPMO's benefits realisation framework to help measure and report the return on investment of internal initiatives.
   

  

**Core Responsibilities** 
  

  

* Lead allocated EPMO projects — Tier 1 (Explore), Tier 2 (Build) or Tier 3 (Transform) — based on experience and demonstrated capability. This includes development and execution of scope, schedule, budget, resource, risk, change, communications and stakeholder management plans, applied proportionate to project tier and complexity.
* Apply consistent project management principles across all allocated projects, working within the EPMO's flexible delivery framework and adhering to its intake, scoring, governance, reporting and closeout standards.
* For Tier 2 initiatives, partner with the nominated business sponsor to develop and refine concise business cases, ensuring scope, rationale, cost, effort and expected return on investment are clearly articulated and aligned with EPMO scoring criteria.
* For Tier 3 initiatives, deliver under the strategic oversight of the EPMO Director, ensuring full governance is observed and that the named ELT sponsor is appropriately engaged throughout the project lifecycle.
* Contribute to the EPMO's benefits realisation framework — capturing baseline measures at planning, tracking realised benefits through delivery, and providing inputs to the EPMO's ROI and outcomes reporting back to ELT.
* Maintain accurate, current project records in the EPMO portfolio dashboard, including status, resourcing, risks, issues, dependencies, scope changes and benefits\-tracking data.
* Facilitate the requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, training and change management activities required for successful project delivery, working collaboratively with subject matter experts and vendors.
* Identify and escalate emerging risks, scope changes or threshold breaches (effort, cost, dependency) that may trigger tier escalation, in line with the EPMO operating model.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including IT, Technology and Innovation, Quality and Compliance, Finance, Clinical Operations and Senior Management to negotiate resource commitments and ensure on\-time delivery of projects.
* Manage external vendors associated with project deliverables, ensuring scope, schedule and contractual obligations are met.
* Provide regular project status updates and portfolio inputs to the EPMO Director, and contribute to monthly ELT portfolio reporting packs.
* Support continuous improvement of the EPMO's tools, templates, processes and benefits\-tracking methods through feedback, adoption discipline and lessons learned.
* Other duties as directed by Line Management or delegate in line with skills, experience and/or qualifications. Qualifications, Skills and Experience
+ Ordinary degree or equivalent in an appropriate discipline and appropriate industry experience.
+ Bachelor's degree in Project Management, Business, Computer Science or other relevant discipline, and/or recognised project management certifications (e.g. PMP, PRINCE2, Agile/Scrum). Higher tier projects will typically require more advanced qualifications and demonstrated delivery track record.
+ Demonstrated project management experience scaled to the tier of project to be managed:
+ Tier 1 (Explore): early\-career project management experience or relevant transferable experience supporting small, single\-team initiatives.
+ Tier 2 (Build): a minimum of 3 years managing cross\-functional internal projects with named sponsors and defined business cases.

**Company Description** 




 A subsidiary of Messe Frankfurt Exhibition GmbH, Messe Frankfurt Trade Fairs India Pvt Ltd is a leading organizer in the exhibition and conference industry with over 25 years of experience in India. With offices in Mumbai and Delhi, the company serves the B2B markets of the Indian sub\-continent with a dedicated workforce of over 100 professionals. Known for its expertise in trade\-fair marketing, it promotes Indian brands globally through outbound trade shows in various verticals such as automotive, textiles, lighting, technology, entertainment, media, consumer goods, and environment technology.
 



  





**Role Description** 




 This is a full\-time on\-site role located at Jasola, New Delhi for a Conference Producer.
 



 The Conference Producer is responsible for the development of timely and relevant conferences in the marketplace. This will mainly encompass industry research, content (programme) development, speaker acquisition, managing sales team, managing conference budget and event execution. 
 



  





**Job Descriptions:** 



* Research and analyze the feasibility of developing potential conference topics into commercially viable events. In case of flagship Conference brands with several past editions already held – having a thorough market intelligence and updated awareness of the key developments in the concerned industry sector, pertinent to the business, ability to research, consult advisors (industry experts) and draft a conference agenda validated by external advisors (industry experts) and/or “Knowledge Partner”, such that the event would garner maximum delegate registrations and sponsor participation.

* To liaise with marketing department to organize event marketing, promotion, publicity, sales and related campaigns. Provide relevant content for the event collaterals, event website and on\- going marketing activities
* Supervise direct sales for attendance of delegates \& for potential sponsors
* Hold regular weekly meetings with the conference sales team consisting of delegate and sponsorship sales team members to review weekly target achievement progress, and set the target for the next week’s sales revenue
* Manage pre\-conference, on\-site \& post conference tasks
* Communicate key conference information to the team members, Immediate Reporting/Line manager and Head of the Division
* Manage conference budget, financial and cash for the conference

description:
Job Title Senior Project Manager Job Description Summary We are looking for an experienced PMC Project Manager with 15+ years of experience in managing large-scale construction projects from the Client/PMC side.
 
The candidate will act as the Client''s representative and overall project delivery lead, providing independent oversight and management of the project across time, cost, quality, safety, contracts, procurement, design coordination and construction.
 
The position is suitable for candidates with experience in major residential, commercial, hospital, hotel, institutional or mixed-use developments in Bangalore or similar major markets.
 
The Project Manager will be responsible for ensuring that the project is delivered in accordance with the Client''s objectives, approved budget, programme, design intent, quality standards and contractual requirements.
 
The candidate must be capable of managing large contractors and multiple consultants and should have sufficient technical, commercial and contractual knowledge to challenge, guide and control contractor performance on behalf of the Client. Job Description 1. Position Overview We are looking for an experienced PMC Project Manager with 15+ years of experience in managing large-scale construction projects from the Client/PMC side. The candidate will act as the Client''s representative and overall project delivery lead , providing independent oversight and management of the project across time, cost, quality, safety, contracts, procurement, design coordination and construction . The position is suitable for candidates with experience in major residential, commercial, hospital, hotel, institutional or mixed-use developments in Bangalore or similar major markets. The Project Manager will be responsible for ensuring that the project is delivered in accordance with the Client''s objectives, approved budget, programme, design intent, quality standards and contractual requirements . The candidate must be capable of managing large contractors and multiple consultants and should have sufficient technical, commercial and contractual knowledge to challenge, guide and control contractor performance on behalf of the Client . 2. Primary Role Client Representative The PMC Project Manager shall function as the single-point project delivery lead for the PMC , representing the Client''s interests at site. Key responsibilities include: Provide overall leadership to the PMC project team. Act as the primary interface between the Client, PMC, consultants and contractors. Establish project management and governance systems. Ensure that project objectives are clearly communicated to all stakeholders. Monitor and control contractor performance against contractual obligations. Identify project risks and recommend appropriate mitigation measures. Provide independent advice to the Client on project progress, risks, costs, delays and contractual matters. Ensure that all major project decisions are supported by appropriate technical, commercial and schedule analysis. Maintain complete transparency in reporting project status to the Client. Ensure that the Client''s interests are protected throughout the project lifecycle. 3. Project Planning & Schedule Management The Project Manager shall provide overall leadership for project planning and programme control. Responsibilities include: Review and approve the overall Project Master Programme prepared by the Planning team. Review contractor baseline programmes and detailed L2/L3/L4 schedules. Ensure alignment between design, procurement, construction, testing and commissioning schedules. Monitor actual progress against the approved baseline. Identify critical path and near-critical activities. Monitor achievement of contractual and project milestones. Review contractor look-ahead programmes and recovery schedules. Challenge unrealistic contractor programmes and claimed progress. Review the impact of design changes, approvals, procurement and site constraints on the programme. Ensure timely implementation of recovery and mitigation measures. Review and advise the Client on potential Extension of Time claims. Coordinate delay analysis and schedule impact assessments. Ensure that project completion forecasts are realistic and evidence-based. 4. Construction Management Provide overall supervision and management of construction activities through the PMC team. Ensure that contractors execute works in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, method statements and contracts. Monitor construction methodology and sequencing. Ensure adequate deployment of manpower, plant, equipment and materials. Monitor productivity and identify underperformance. Coordinate civil, structural, architectural, MEP, faade, interiors, landscape and external development works. Manage interfaces between various contractors and packages. Identify construction constraints and coordinate timely resolution. Ensure that site activities are properly coordinated to avoid rework and disruption. Monitor construction quality and progress through regular site inspections and reviews. Ensure timely escalation of critical issues to the Client. 5. Contractor Management A key responsibility of the PMC Project Manager will be to manage and control contractor performance on behalf of the Client . The candidate shall: Review contractor mobilisation and resource deployment. Monitor manpower, plant, equipment and material availability. Assess contractor productivity and performance. Conduct regular contractor performance reviews. Establish clear performance expectations and corrective actions. Issue/coordinate appropriate contractual communications through the PMC. Challenge contractor delays, inadequate resources and poor productivity. Review contractor recovery plans. Monitor compliance with contractual milestones. Recommend appropriate contractual remedies in case of persistent underperformance. Ensure that contractor commitments made during progress meetings are tracked and closed. Maintain proper records of contractor performance, delays and non-compliances. 6. Contract Administration & Claims Management The Project Manager shall provide strong oversight of contract administration and claims. Responsibilities include: Review construction contracts and understand key commercial and contractual obligations. Ensure that PMC teams monitor contractor compliance with contractual requirements. Review contractor notices, claims, variations and EOT submissions. Coordinate with the QS/Commercial Manager for evaluation of variations and claims. Ensure timely assessment of additional cost and time implications. Review contractual entitlement and supporting documentation. Ensure proper recording of delay events and Client/contractor responsibilities. Coordinate preparation of recommendations to the Client. Protect the Client from unjustified claims and cost escalation. Ensure that contractual correspondence is properly documented. Assist in dispute avoidance and resolution. Working knowledge of FIDIC, EPC, Design & Build and Item Rate contracts is preferred. 7. Cost Management The PMC Project Manager shall provide overall oversight of project cost control. Responsibilities include: Monitor project cost against the approved budget. Review cost reports prepared by the commercial/QS team. Monitor committed, certified, actual and forecast expenditure. Review variations and change orders. Assess cost impact of design changes and Client instructions. Monitor potential cost overruns. Review contractor claims and commercial submissions. Ensure appropriate approvals are obtained for variations. Monitor project contingency and risk allowances. Provide the Client with an independent assessment of the forecast final cost. Ensure cost and programme implications are considered before recommending major changes. 8. Design Management Coordinate with architects, structural consultants, MEP consultants and specialist consultants. Monitor design deliverables against the construction programme. Ensure timely release of Good for Construction drawings. Identify design gaps and interface issues. Ensure timely closure of RFIs and technical queries. Coordinate design reviews and constructability reviews. Monitor design changes and assess their impact on cost and programme. Coordinate BIM/clash detection processes where applicable. Ensure that construction does not proceed based on incomplete or unapproved information. Maintain a design deliverables and approval tracker. 9. Procurement Management Review and monitor the project procurement strategy. Ensure procurement schedules are aligned with the master programme. Monitor long-lead items and critical equipment. Review vendor approval and material submittal processes. Monitor procurement risks and potential delays. Ensure timely release of purchase orders and subcontract packages. Coordinate procurement with design and construction requirements. Escalate procurement issues that could affect project milestones. Monitor delivery of critical materials and equipment to site. 10. Quality Management The PMC Project Manager shall ensure that the Client''s quality objectives are achieved. Responsibilities include: Implement and monitor the Project Quality Management Plan. Review contractor quality plans and inspection procedures. Monitor compliance with project specifications and approved materials. Ensure inspection and testing procedures are followed. Review quality audits and inspection reports. Monitor NCRs, observations and corrective actions. Identify recurring quality issues and implement preventive measures. Ensure appropriate mock-ups and benchmark samples are approved. Monitor workmanship and finishing standards. Ensure quality documentation is complete for project handover. 11. Health, Safety & Environment Provide leadership to ensure a strong project safety culture. Monitor contractor compliance with HSE requirements. Review contractor HSE plans and performance. Ensure regular safety audits and inspections. Monitor high-risk construction activities. Ensure timely closure of safety observations. Escalate serious safety violations to the Client. Promote a zero-incident / zero-tolerance approach to unsafe practices . Ensure environmental and statutory requirements are complied with. 12. Risk Management The Project Manager shall lead the PMC''s project risk-management process. Responsibilities include: Establish and maintain the Project Risk Register. Identify risks related to: Programme Cost Design Procurement Contractor performance Quality Safety Statutory approvals Contracts and claims Stakeholder interfaces Assess probability and potential impact. Develop mitigation and contingency measures. Monitor implementation of risk mitigation actions. Escalate high-impact risks to the Client. Ensure emerging risks are identified before they become project issues. 13. Project Controls & MIS Ensure that the PMC project controls system provides the Client with an accurate and timely view of project performance. The Project Manager shall review: Master schedule Monthly progress S-curves Critical path Milestone tracking Contractor performance Cost reports Variation/change register Procurement tracker Design tracker Material approval tracker Risk register Issue register NCR/quality tracker HSE performance Manpower and productivity Claims/EOT register Forecast completion dates Forecast final cost The candidate should be capable of interpreting project data and converting it into actionable recommendations , rather than merely reviewing reports. 14. Client Reporting & Stakeholder Management Act as the primary PMC interface with the Client. Conduct weekly and monthly project review meetings. Prepare management-level project reports. Present project status, key risks, delays and commercial issues to senior Client management. Provide clear recommendations and alternative solutions. Ensure timely escalation of critical decisions. Manage expectations of Client, consultants and contractors. Maintain transparent and professional communication with all stakeholders. Ensure that decisions and commitments are properly recorded and followed through. 15. Testing, Commissioning & Handover Develop and monitor the overall testing and commissioning strategy. Coordinate commissioning of MEP and specialist systems. Monitor statutory inspections and approvals. Coordinate snagging and de-snagging activities. Monitor completion of all works against the approved scope. Ensure as-built drawings and O&M manuals are completed. Ensure warranties, test certificates and statutory documentation are compiled. Coordinate final handover to the Client. Ensure smooth transition from construction to operations. 16. PMC Team Leadership The Project Manager will lead and coordinate the PMC team, which may include: Planning Engineer Civil/Structural Engineers Architectural/Finishes Engineers MEP Engineers QA/QC Engineers Safety Engineers QS/Commercial Manager Contracts/Claims personnel Procurement specialists Document Controllers Other specialist consultants Responsibilities include: Define roles and responsibilities. Establish reporting structures. Monitor individual and team performance. Ensure adequate staffing against project requirements. Coordinate multidisciplinary activities. Ensure timely reporting and escalation. Build a strong, collaborative PMC team culture. 17. Authority & Decision-Making The candidate should have the maturity to distinguish between matters that can be resolved at project level and those requiring Client approval. The Project Manager shall: Provide technical and commercial recommendations to the Client. Recommend acceptance/rejection of contractor submissions. Recommend corrective measures for contractor underperformance. Recommend recovery strategies. Recommend variations and change orders based on technical/commercial evaluation. Recommend contractual action where justified. Escalate matters requiring Client approval with clear options and implications. The role is primarily one of independent review, management and recommendation on behalf of the Client, rather than routine contractor supervision. 18. Educational Qualification Mandatory B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering from a recognised institution. Preferred M.Tech / MBA / Post Graduate qualification in Construction or Project Management. PMP / PMI / RICS or equivalent professional certification is an advantage. 19. Experience Requirements 15+ years of total experience in construction/project management. Minimum 810 years in Project Manager / Senior Project Manager / Construction Manager / PMC leadership roles preferred. Demonstrated experience in managing large-scale building projects. Strong Client/PMC-side experience preferred. Experience managing multiple contractors and consultants. Experience in large and complex projects with significant civil, architectural, MEP and specialist interfaces. Preferred Project Experience Experience in one or more of the following: High-rise residential developments Commercial developments Super-speciality hospitals Hotels and hospitality Mixed-use developments Institutional projects Large corporate campuses 20. Technical & Professional Competencies Strong working knowledge of: Construction Management Project Management Primavera P6 / MS Project Project Controls Contract Administration FIDIC / EPC / Design & Build / Item Rate Contracts Cost Management Quantity Surveying fundamentals Variations & Change Management Claims & EOT Delay Analysis Quality Management HSE Management Procurement Management Risk Management Design Management MEP Coordination Testing & Commissioning Advanced MS Excel and MS Office BIM coordination awareness Project dashboards/MIS 21. Leadership & Behavioural Competencies The candidate should demonstrate: Strong leadership and people-management skills. Excellent Client and stakeholder-management capability. Strong technical understanding of building construction. Strong commercial and contractual awareness. Ability to challenge contractors objectively and professionally. Excellent negotiation and conflict-resolution skills. Strong analytical and problem-solving capability. Ability to make decisions under pressure. Excellent written and verbal communication. Strong presentation skills. High degree of ownership and accountability. Ability to manage multiple priorities and interfaces. Proactive approach to risk identification and mitigation. 22. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Project Delivery Achievement of project milestones. Overall programme performance. Effectiveness of recovery strategies. Cost Project cost within approved budget. Control of variations and claims. Accuracy of cost forecasting. Contractor Performance Contractor productivity. Resource deployment. Schedule adherence. Quality and HSE performance. Quality Reduction in NCRs and recurring defects. Timely closure of quality issues. Successful completion and handover. Safety HSE compliance. Reduction/prevention of incidents. Timely closure of safety observations. Client Satisfaction Quality and transparency of reporting. Timely resolution of issues. Quality of recommendations. Effective stakeholder coordination. 23. Ideal Candidate Profile The ideal candidate will be a senior construction professional with strong PMC/Client-side experience , capable of independently managing the delivery of a major project and providing objective advice to the Client. He/she should be able to move beyond routine supervision and provide strategic project leadership , with a strong understanding of: Programme + Cost + Quality + Safety + Contracts + Claims + Procurement + Design + Construction The candidate should be comfortable challenging major contractors such as L&T, Shapoorji Pallonji, Tata Projects, NCC, Afcons or equivalent , while maintaining a professional and collaborative relationship. The successful candidate should be able to look at a project from the Client''s overall perspective , identify the root cause of problems, quantify their impact, recommend corrective action and drive the project team and contractors towards achieving the agreed project objectives. Location Bangalore, Karnataka The role requires full-time presence at the project site with regular interaction with the Client, consultants, contractors, vendors and other project stakeholders. title: Senior Program Manager - Service Management
description:
**About Us**
 Join us at Orange Business!
   

  

 We are a network and digital integrator that understands the entire value chain of the digital world, freeing our customers to focus on the strategic initiatives that shape their business.
   

  

 Every day, you will collaborate with a team dedicated to providing consistent, sustainable global solutions, no matter where our customers operate. With over 30,000 employees across Asia, the Americas, Africa, and Europe, we offer a dynamic environment to develop and perfect your skills in a field filled with exciting challenges and opportunities.
   

  

**About The Role**
**Role Overview:**
 The Senior Manager – Service Management is a senior technical expert responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing Telco Service Management solutions on the ServiceNow platform. This role focuses on delivering enterprise\-grade Service management capabilities, including IT Asset Management (ITAM), sovereignty compliance, and on\-premises deployments, ensuring scalable, secure, and efficient service delivery aligned with business needs.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Solution Design \& Architecture**
* Lead the design of Telco Service Management solutions on ServiceNow, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture standards.
* Develop scalable, secure, and compliant architecture models for on\-premises ServiceNow deployments.
* Integrate ServiceNow with existing systems, APIs, and third\-party tools to enable seamless workflows.
* Implement best practices for data sovereignty, privacy, and security within the platform.


**Technical Leadership \& Implementation**
* Provide technical guidance during the deployment of ServiceNow modules related to Telco Service Management, ITAM, strategic portfolio management \& FSM.
* Customize and configure ServiceNow to meet complex business requirements, including scripting, Flow Designer, and integrations.
* Lead technical workshops, reviews, and validation sessions with stakeholders and development teams.


**Governance \& Standards**
* Establish technical standards, governance frameworks, and best practices for ServiceNow implementations.
* Ensure solutions adhere to security, compliance, and regulatory standards, especially related to sovereignty.


**Continuous Improvement \& Innovation**
* Stay current with ServiceNow product updates, industry trends, and emerging technologies like Agentic AI, AI control tower, Workflow data fabric etc.,
* Identify opportunities for automation, process optimization, and platform enhancements.
* Drive innovation initiatives to modernize and optimize Telco service management capabilities.


**Stakeholder Collaboration**
* Act as a trusted technical advisor to business leaders, project teams, and vendors.
* Translate business requirements into technical solutions and architecture blueprints.
* Support project teams with technical expertise during implementation phases.


**About You**
**Qualifications \& Skills**
* Extensive experience (10\+ years) in ServiceNow architecture, development, and implementation.
* Deep expertise in Telco Service Management, ITAM, sovereignty, and on\-premises \& sovereign ServiceNow deployments.
* Strong scripting skills (JavaScript, Glide), API integrations, and Flow Designer.
* Proven ability to design scalable, secure, and compliant platform solutions.
* Knowledge of enterprise architecture standards and best practices.
* Relevant certifications (e.g., ServiceNow CMA, CTA, CIS, CAD ) are preferred.


**Success Metrics**
* Successful delivery of scalable, secure ServiceNow solutions aligned with enterprise standards.
* Seamless integration and automation of Telco service workflows.
* High platform stability, security, and compliance adherence.


 Positive stakeholder feedback on solution effectiveness and innovation
   

  

**What We Offer**
* Global Opportunities: Work in multi\-national teams with opportunity to collaborate with colleagues and customers from all over the world.
* Flexible Work Environment: Flexible working hours and possibility to combine work from office and home (hybrid ways of working).
* Professional Development: training programs and upskilling/re\-skilling opportunities.
* Career Growth: Internal growth and mobility opportunities within Orange.
* Caring and Daring Culture: Health and well\-being programs and benefits, diversity \& inclusion initiatives, CSR and employee connect events.
* Reward Programs: Employee Referral Program, Change Maker Awards.


**Only Your Skills Matter**
 Regardless of your age, gender identity, race, ethnic origin, religion/belief, sexual orientation, marital status, neurotype, disability, veteran status or appearance, we encourage diversity within our teams because it is a strength for the collective and a vector of innovation. Orange Group is a disabled\-friendly company and equal opportunity employer: don't hesitate to tell us about your specific needs.

* Completes Power Management System\-related risk and opportunity assessments and ensures implementation of resulting actions in one’s area of responsibility. Reports any contract/quality/program/cost issues to management along with recommendations for resolution.
* Collaborates with the Supply Chain function to ensure that technical requirements for equipment or services are communicated and agreed on with potential suppliers. Provides technical evaluation of supplier proposals and accepts as fit for purpose supplied equipment or services.

Reports process and tool inefficiencies and suggest improvement ideas. Assigns tasks to and coordinates work with entry\-level engineers, technicians, and administrative staff.


You will join a talented team, where you will be able to thrive.


**Qualifications for the role**


* Minimum 4\&\#43; years of relevant experience in engineering and commissioning of Power Management Systems (PMS), covering functionalities such as primary equipment monitoring and control, load shedding, load sharing, and synchronization.
* Hands\-on experience in designing substation network architecture of control systems and control philosophy for process/power plants.
* Working knowledge of utility communication protocols like IEC 61850, OPC, Modbus, DNP3, IEC 101/104, TCP/IP, Prefab’s, Profinet, Fieldbus, SPA, convergence of OT/IT, cybersecurity, etc. Hands\-on experience with application engineering tools for any DCS.
* Hands\-on experience in configuring controllers, protocol gateways, and data concentrators on various communication protocols. Experience working with various manufacturer IEDs on IEC 61850 protocol, creating IEC, ICD, CID, and SCD files.
* Bachelor's degree (4 years) or equivalent experience, and willingness to travel nationally and internationally up to 70%. Valid international passport.

With over 50 years of domain knowledge, we continue to innovate and reshape traditional approaches across the energy sector with our technologies designed to improve operational efficiency, reduce risk, reduce energy consumption and waste.
