title: Principal Project Manager
description:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale - across every customer touchpoint. By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer-facing team - spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management - enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real-time insights. Today, 1,900+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide. Job Description Sprinklr is a leading enterprise software company for all customer-facing functions. With advanced AI, Sprinklrs unified customer experience management (Unified-CXM) platform helps companies deliver human experiences to every customer, every time, across any modern channel. Headquartered in New York City with employees around the world, Sprinklr works with more than 1,000 of the world s most valuable enterprises - global brands like Microsoft, P&G, Samsung and more than 50% of the Fortune 100. Learn more about our culture and how we make our employees happier through The Sprinklr Way. Meet our Professional Services Team! Successful value-driven Sprinklr implementations start with us. We re looking for an experienced Global Program Manager to help provide premium services to our global customer base. As a member of our team, you ll support customers through the initial stages of their Sprinklr journey and work with a team of passionate internal consultants, solutions designers, analytics experts, as well as sales and service delivery leaders to make it happen. About the Role: We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Global Program Manager to lead the large-scale, complex global rollout of Sprinklr SaaS & CCaaS products. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record in managing global programs, excellent leadership skills, and the ability to drive cross-functional teams towards successful project delivery. Key Responsibilities: Program Leadership: Oversee the planning, execution, and delivery of the global rollout of Sprinklr SaaS & CCaaS products, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives. Stakeholder Management: Engage with key stakeholders, including senior management, clients, and cross-functional teams, to ensure clear communication and alignment on program goals and progress. Resource Management: Allocate, coordinate and manage resources across different regions and functions effectively to ensure timely delivery of program milestones. Risk Management: Identify, assess, and mitigate risks associated with the program to ensure smooth execution. Performance Tracking: Monitor program performance using appropriate systems, tools, and techniques; report on progress, issues, and risks to stakeholders. Continuous Improvement: Implement best practices and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance program efficiency and effectiveness. Compliance: Ensure all program activities comply with relevant regulations, standards, and organizational policies. Financial Management: Manage program budgets, monitor expenditures, and ensure financial targets are met. Mentorship : Supervise and mentor program teams, providing guidance and support to ensure project success. Experience and Qualifications: Education: Bachelors degree in business administration, Project Management, Information Technology, or a related field is preferred. Experience: Minimum of 7-10 years of experience in program management, with at least 5 years managing large-scale, global programs. Certifications: PMP, PMI-ACP, or equivalent program management certification is highly desirable. Technical Skills: Strong understanding of SaaS and CCaaS products & technology. (Salesforce, ServiceNow, Avaya, Cisco, Genysis etc.) Leadership Skills: Proven ability to lead and motivate cross-functional teams in a global, matrixed environment. Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present complex information clearly and concisely to various audiences. Analytical Skills: Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to make data-driven decisions. Adaptability: Ability to adapt to changing priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. Negotiation & Conflict Management: Experience in negotiation and conflict resolution to manage stakeholder expectations and drive consensus. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs): On-Time Delivery: Percentage of program milestones delivered on or before the scheduled date. Budget Adherence: Percentage of program budget adherence, ensuring costs do not exceed allocated budget. Stakeholder Satisfaction: Stakeholder satisfaction scores based on feedback from clients, senior management, and team members. Risk Mitigation: Number of identified risks successfully mitigated or managed without impacting program delivery. Resource Utilization: Efficiency of resource allocation and utilization, ensuring optimal use of available resources. Quality of Deliverables: Quality assessment scores of program deliverables, ensuring they meet or exceed defined standards. Team Performance: Performance metrics for cross-functional teams, including productivity and collaboration effectiveness. Continuous Improvement: Implementation of process improvements and best practices, measured by the number of initiatives successfully adopted. Desired Soft Skills: Emotional Intelligence: Ability to understand and manage your own emotions, and those of others, to foster a positive work environment. Collaboration: Strong team player with the ability to work effectively with diverse teams across different geographies. Conflict Resolution: Skilled in resolving conflicts and negotiating win-win solutions. Time Management: Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines. Critical Thinking: Ability to think critically and creatively to solve complex problems. Resilience: Ability to remain calm and focused under pressure, and to bounce back from setbacks. Cultural Sensitivity: Awareness and respect for cultural differences, with the ability to work effectively in a global context. Why Join Us Opportunity to lead a high-impact global program. Collaborative and inclusive work environment. Competitive salary and benefits package. Professional development and growth opportunities. We focus on our mission : Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data - helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things: Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified-CXM. Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience. Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability. We believe in our product : Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything - and everyone - can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world s leading enterprise brands. We invest in our people : We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help each member of our team thrive. Sprinklr believes that you should be able to get the type of care you need for your personal well-being when you need it. We offer you and your family voluntary healthcare coverage in countries where applicable. We believe it is important to take time off - it is essential for your mental and physical wellbeing. We provide Sprinklrites with paid time off to recharge and spend time with loved ones. We want to grow our talent with purpose. Our open Mentoring Program is designed to create meaningful connections that support growth and amplify our focus. To learn more about employee benefits by region, click here . To learn more about all-things-Sprinklr, visit our candidate resource hub here . EEO - Our philosophy : Our goal is to ensure every employee feels like they belong and are operating in a collaborative environment. We fervently believe every employee matters and should be respected and heard. We believe we are stronger when we belong because collectively, we re more innovative, creative, and successful. Sprinklr is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), age, physical or mental disability, citizenship, past, current, or prospective service in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law. Reasonable accommodations are available upon request during the interview process. To request an accommodation, please work directly with your recruitment coordinator or recruiter. Warning about Recruiting Scams: Please be vigilant for recruiting scams impersonating Sprinklr. Sprinklr will never ask you for money, to pay for equipment, or for unnecessary personal information during the interview process. Sprinklr will also never pay in Bitcoin or send email communications from our executives. Please review the Federal Trade Commissions advice to avoid these types of scams. If you are contacted by someone whom you suspect may not be appropriately representing Sprinklr, please do not engage and block their email or phone number immediately.

**Job Description**
**Position Summary**
 Construction Manager is responsible for planning, coordinating, and managing all construction activities associated with a large\-scale mining plant project. The role will provide construction leadership during project development from the Home Office and subsequently assume full responsibility for on\-site construction execution, ensuring the project is delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with quality and technical requirements.
   

  

 The successful candidate will possess extensive experience in construction management of mining and mineral processing plant, with strong leadership capabilities and a proven track record of managing multidisciplinary construction teams, contractors, and stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Home Office Phase**
* Participate in project planning, constructability reviews, and execution strategy development.
* Support engineering, procurement, contracting, and project controls teams during project development.
* Review engineering deliverables to ensure construction readiness and efficient execution.
* Develop construction management plans, site mobilization plans, and workforce strategies.
* Participate in contractor prequalification, tender evaluations, and contract award recommendations.
* Develop construction schedules, resource plans, and site logistics strategies.
* Support HSE planning and project risk assessments.
* Coordinate with engineering and procurement teams to ensure timely material and equipment availability.


**Site Construction Phase**
* Lead and manage all site construction activities for the mining plant project.
* Ensure compliance with project safety, quality, environmental, and regulatory requirements.
* Direct EPC/EPCM contractors, subcontractors, and field construction teams.
* Monitor construction progress against approved schedules and budgets.
* Resolve field execution challenges and coordinate multidisciplinary interfaces.
* Conduct regular site inspections and construction progress reviews.
* Ensure quality control and adherence to project specifications and standards.
* Review and approve contractor work plans, method statements, and construction procedures.
* Coordinate with commissioning and start\-up teams to facilitate smooth project handover.
* Prepare and present regular progress reports to project leadership and stakeholders.
* Promote a strong safety culture and ensure implementation of company HSE policies.


 Basic Job Requirements
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering from an accredited university.
* Required Experienceo Minimum 15 years of experience in construction management of \-
* Mining projects
* Mineral processing plants
* Ore handling facilities
* Heavy industrial facilities
* Large\-scale EPC/EPCM projects
* Minimum 5 years in a lead Construction Manager role on major mining or process plant projects.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in greenfield mining project development and execution.
* International project experience in mining or heavy industrial sectors.
* Experience with commissioning and start\-up of mineral processing facilities.
* Familiarity with international construction standards and mining industry regulations.


**Other Job Requirements**

**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for a Technical Program Manager to lead delivery across the engineering teams supporting our health plan technology platform, spanning software engineering (Junior through Architect levels, working in Go, Python, Node.js, and AWS\-based distributed systems), Data \& Integration Engineering (AWS Glue, Power BI, Message Broker/ACE), and DevOps \& Cloud Engineering (AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes/EKS/OpenShift). This is a techno\-functional leadership role: you will own the program plan, translate customer and business requirements into clear technical direction, and track delivery across multiple concurrent workstreams and onshore/offshore teams. Just as important, you will be the driving force behind an AI\-first mindset across every team and every solution, setting the expectation that AI\-assisted engineering is the default way of working, not an exception.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own end\-to\-end program and project delivery across engineering teams spanning software engineering, data/BI \& integration engineering, and DevOps/cloud engineering
* Partner directly with customer and business stakeholders to understand business priorities, constraints, and success criteria within the health insurance/payer domain
* Translate business and customer requirements into clear technical requirements, epics, and stories, ensuring shared understanding across product, architecture, and delivery teams
* Build, maintain, and track detailed program plans, schedules, dependencies, RAID logs, and status reporting across all workstreams
* Drive sprint/iteration planning, backlog grooming, and delivery governance (Agile/Scrum/Kanban) across distributed onshore/offshore teams
* Champion and drive an AI\-first engineering mindset across all teams, ensuring AI\-assisted coding, testing, documentation, and operations practices are adopted consistently across every solution delivered
* Identify opportunities to apply AI and automation to accelerate delivery, improve quality, or reduce operational cost, and drive adoption plans together with engineering and architecture leads
* Manage cross\-team dependencies across software engineering, data/BI/integration, and DevOps/cloud engineering roles, proactively resolving blockers
* Own stakeholder communication: executive status updates, steering committee reporting, and risk/issue escalation
* Partner with architects on technical roadmap alignment with business priorities
* Ensure delivery quality, compliance, and security requirements, including HIPAA\-aware practices, are embedded into program execution
* Mentor and guide engineering leads on program management fundamentals and on driving AI\-first delivery within their teams



**Required Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field; PMP, PMI\-ACP, CSM, or SAFe certification is a plus
* 12–15 years of experience in technical program or project management, including delivery of complex, multi\-team software engineering programs
* Strong working knowledge of AWS services and cloud architecture concepts, sufficient to engage credibly with engineering and architecture teams on technical trade\-offs
* Proven experience managing programs spanning distributed systems/backend engineering, data engineering/BI, and DevOps/cloud engineering disciplines
* Strong command of program/project management tools and methodologies (Agile/Scrum/Kanban, JIRA, Confluence, MS Project, or similar), including building and tracking project plans, RAID logs, and status reports
* Demonstrated ability to understand customer and business context and translate business requirements into actionable technical direction for engineering teams
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills to track progress, surface risks early, and drive resolution across multiple concurrent workstreams
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, including experience presenting to senior stakeholders and clients
* Experience managing and coordinating distributed onshore/offshore delivery teams
* Strong stakeholder management skills across business, engineering, and executive audiences



**AI\-First Leadership (Required)** 



* A genuine AI\-first mindset: able to identify, champion, and drive adoption of AI\-assisted engineering practices (AI coding assistants, agentic workflows, AI\-assisted testing and documentation) across every team and every solution under their management
* Practical, hands\-on familiarity with AI coding/assistant tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar), sufficient to credibly set expectations and coach teams on effective, responsible usage
* Able to define and track AI\-adoption goals and metrics across engineering teams (e.g., proportion of AI\-assisted work, cycle\-time improvement, quality impact) as part of program governance
* Understanding of responsible and compliant AI usage in a health\-insurance context, including data\-privacy safeguards such as never exposing PHI or sensitive member/client data to external AI tools, and the ability to enforce these standards across teams
* Able to evaluate where AI can be applied across the full solution lifecycle, requirements analysis, design, coding, testing, documentation, and operations, and build these expectations into program plans
* Comfortable partnering with architects and engineering leads to embed AI\-first practices into technical roadmaps and solution designs



**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Experience in the US health insurance or payer domain: claims, eligibility, enrollment, provider/member data, and HIPAA\-aware program delivery
* Experience managing programs supporting health plan clients in a consulting or professional services environment
* Familiarity with the specific technologies used by the teams under management: Go, Python, Node.js, AWS EKS/OpenShift, AWS Glue, Power BI, IBM Message Broker/ACE, and cloud DevOps toolchains (Terraform, CI/CD)
* AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner or AWS Certified Solutions Architect (Associate)
* Experience establishing AI governance frameworks or an AI center\-of\-excellence function within an engineering organization

title: Program Manager
description:
**Position:** 
 Program Manager – Urban Initiative
 



**Location:** 
 Delhi
 



**An initiative supported by The Convergence Foundation** 




  





**About URBAN Project** 




 India is urbanising rapidly, and its cities are where the country's economic future will be decided. Services already form the largest part of the Indian economy, and well\-functioning cities are essential to sustaining services\-led growth and creating jobs at scale. Yet urbanisation in India has often been unplanned and under\-resourced, leaving cities struggling with weak planning, a difficult business environment, fragmented governance, and chronic under\-financing. Getting urbanisation right – rapid yet sustainable – is one of the highest\-leverage opportunities for India's economic transformation.
 



  





 The Urban Initiative is supported by The Convergence Foundation, the Urban Initiative is being established to help India build the policy ecosystem needed to drive economic growth through rapid and sustainable urbanisation. It will work systemically—developing policy perspectives and partnering with the government to advance reform—rather than engaging in on\-ground implementation. Its work will be organised around four interconnected pillars:
 



  




* **Regional economic and spatial planning:** 
 Creating regional economic plans that feed into better, more growth\-oriented master plans for cities and their surrounding regions.
* **Ease of doing business:** 
 Enabling more sensible development control norms and regulations that make it easier to build, invest and do business in cities.
* **Governance:** 
 Strengthening how cities are managed, including the devolution of power to empowered, accountable city governments.
* **Financing:** 
 Ensuring cities are adequately funded and well managed – through better allocation of public money, raising local resources, and involving the private sector through PPP and other models.



  





 Across each pillar, the initiative will build a strong policy perspective, drawing on best practices from better\-run Indian cities as well as relevant global examples. It will work closely with the central government – including NITI Aayog and the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA) – to drive policy change at the national level, and with state and city governments where there is genuine interest and appetite for reform. The initiative will remain a small, high\-quality team focused on ideas, influence and partnerships rather than implementation.
 



  





**Position Summary** 




 The Economic growth team works with internal and external stakeholders on cross functional projects. This role sits within the team's Urban Development initiative, which explores emerging issues and whitespaces in the urban development policy ecosystem. The Program Manager (PM) should have strong problem\-solving skills, secondary research capabilities and analytical prowess. In addition, as well as excellent oral \& written communication skills. The ideal candidate is a self\-starter with a bias towards action and the ability to work with ambiguous requirements. The PM will have a steep learning curve and would be expected to hit the ground running on live projects with Government institutions.
 



  





**Areas of Work:** 




 The Program Manager will:
 


* Work with Economic Growth team and leadership to identify and scope priority areas in the urban development policy ecosystem, with a focus on ease of doing business in cities, urban finance, and city planning
* Engage in dipstick secondary research to diagnose binding constraints in issue areas and develop initial hypotheses around opportunities for impact (e.g. which regulatory constraints, if solved for, can improve ease of doing business in a city)
* Develop evidence\-based benchmarking frameworks to compare cities on regulatory performance and identify opportunities to streamline approvals, improve governance, and accelerate urban economic growth
* Engage with policymakers, urban practitioners, and other ecosystem stakeholders to validate findings, refine priorities, and build partnerships
* Oversee the creation of knowledge material across priority areas by identifying potential partners, developing terms of reference and managing projects to their completion
* Provide continued program/grant support to organisations, programs or public goods that might stem as a result of the scoping exercise



  





**Required Qualifications, Skills and Abilities** 



* Undergraduate or masters degrees from top tier institutions. While there is no preference for a particular major or specialisation, prior experience in urban development or related sectors will be preferred
* Up to 4 years of work experience in a consulting or challenging/ high growth environment
* Excellent analytical, critical thinking and problem\-solving skills
* Solid planning and organisational skills with high attention to detail, accuracy, protocol and deadline
* Excellent writing ability that is clear, concise and analytic in style
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder\-facing skills including solid presentation and facilitation skills
* High level of flexibility and responsiveness with the ability to shift priorities quickly and as organisational demands require
* Ability to do research and distil important concepts in a structured, concise, yet comprehensive manner
* Operating style suited to working in a small\-organisation setting, where teamwork and resourcefulness are highly valued



  





**Compensation** 




 Remuneration will be competitive with Indian philanthropy pay scales and will depend upon the candidate's experience
 



  





**Location** 




 New Delhi, India

title: Technology & Security Project Manager
description:
**Role Overview** 




 This is a site\-embedded SME role focused on the specific ELV, BMS, and security infrastructure of a designated data centre campus or facility. Unlike the portfolio\-level SME role, this position requires deep, facility\-specific technical knowledge — the as\-built configuration, site\-specific control logic, vendor systems in use, and local operational constraints of the assigned site — to provide hands\-on technical support to site operations, construction, and commissioning teams.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Act as the on\-site/site\-dedicated technical point of contact for all ELV, BMS, and security system matters at the assigned facility.
* Maintain detailed, current knowledge of the site's as\-built ELV and BMS architecture, including device inventory, network topology, controller configurations, and integration points with EPMS and fire/life\-safety systems.
* Support live\-site troubleshooting of ELV, BMS, and security system faults, coordinating with OEM vendors and facility operations/NOC teams for rapid resolution.
* Review and validate site\-specific change requests (MOPs/EOPs) affecting ELV, BMS, or security systems before implementation.
* Provide technical walkdown support during audits, client inspections, and compliance reviews specific to the site.
* Support site commissioning and re\-commissioning activities for ELV, BMS, and security systems during capacity expansions, retrofits, or system upgrades.
* Maintain and update site\-specific documentation — as\-built drawings, points lists, network diagrams, and system configuration baselines — reflecting all field changes.
* Coordinate with the portfolio\-level ELV \& Security SME on design standard alignment, escalations, and lessons learned across sites.
* Support incident response and root\-cause investigations for site\-specific ELV/BMS/security events, including data gathering, log review, and vendor coordination.
* Train and guide site facility/operations personnel on ELV and BMS system operation, alarm handling, and basic troubleshooting.



  





**Required Skills \& Experience** 



* 8–12 years of experience in ELV and BMS systems, with demonstrated experience providing hands\-on, site\-level technical support in a live/operational data centre environment.
* Working knowledge of the specific BMS/EPMS platform(s) deployed at the assigned site (e.g., Niagara/Tridium, Schneider EcoStruxure, Siemens Desigo, Honeywell, Johnson Controls Metasys).
* Practical experience with CCTV, access control, intrusion detection, and PA systems as deployed and configured on an operational site.
* Familiarity with MOP/EOP (Method of Procedure / Emergency Operating Procedure) development and change control processes in a live critical facility.
* Ability to interpret as\-built drawings, control narratives, and network diagrams specific to the site, and to identify discrepancies against current field conditions.
* Comfort working in a 24x7 critical facility environment, including responding to on\-call escalations as required.
* Strong troubleshooting mindset with the ability to work directly with OEM technical support and field service engineers.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's degree in Electrical/Electronics/Instrumentation Engineering, or related field, or equivalent hands\-on field experience.
* Site\-specific OEM training/certification on the BMS or security platforms deployed at the facility.
* Prior experience in a site operations, facility engineering, or critical environment support role.



  





**Soft Skills** 




  




* Strong ownership mindset and responsiveness in live\-site, time\-sensitive situations.
* Clear, concise communication with site operations, NOC, and vendor teams during incidents.
* Ability to work independently on site while staying aligned with portfolio\-level design standards and reporting lines.

title: Senior Program Manager
description:
**About PRAGATI** 




 Rural India is central to India's economic future, accounting for 63% of the population and 70% of the workforce. Yet a large share of rural livelihoods remains concentrated in relatively low\-productivity agriculture, creating a significant opportunity to shift towards higher\-income economic activity.
 



 PRAGATI (Programme for Rural Advancement, Growth and Transformative Initiatives) is a TCF\-incubated organisation focused on accelerating economic prosperity in rural India. Its work is centred on two priorities:
 


* Increasing agricultural incomes by addressing structural constraints across land, inputs, finance, markets, processing and trade.
* Creating scalable non\-farm livelihoods by identifying, financing and supporting promising rural enterprises that can generate local jobs.



 PRAGATI works with central ministries and state governments to combine policy and economic analysis with hands\-on implementation. It identifies high\-potential opportunities, partners with relevant government institutions, tests solutions on the ground, and develops models that governments can ultimately own and replicate.
 



 PRAGATI is also leading Amrit Prayas, a 10\-year economic development initiative in the Deoria Lok Sabha constituency. It serves as a live testbed for coordinated interventions across agriculture, agro\-processing, labour\-intensive manufacturing and other growth sectors, with the aim of developing a replicable district transformation playbook.
 



  





**Role Summary** 




 PRAGATI is working with the Ministry of Rural Development (MoRD) to help shape the next phase of rural development — building on MoRD's strong welfare and infrastructure delivery platform to increasingly enable sustained income growth and rural prosperity. The engagement focuses on three pathways: increasing agricultural incomes, creating non\-farm local livelihood opportunities, and enabling skilling for remunerative migration.
 



 The Senior Program Manager – Rural Economic Transformation (MoRD) will lead this engagement on a day\-to\-day basis. The role combines strategy, policy and execution — identifying and structuring complex problems, conducting rigorous analysis, designing practical interventions, building alignment with government and ecosystem stakeholders, and driving initiatives through implementation. The SPM will lead a small team and work closely with senior MoRD officials, PRAGATI leadership, financial institutions, experts and private\-sector partners.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Work with MoRD and PRAGATI leadership to identify and prioritise high\-impact opportunities for increasing rural incomes.
* Structure complex problems into clear hypotheses, analytical workstreams and actionable interventions.
* Lead research and analysis across agriculture, rural enterprise, finance, skilling and migration.
* Translate priority opportunities into practical program and policy designs, including implementation models, financing mechanisms and outcome frameworks.
* Build the economic and operational case for new initiatives and government partnerships, working with experts and ecosystem partners to refine solutions.
* Translate ministry priorities into clear workplans, owners, milestones and deliverables, and establish a strong operating rhythm across workstreams.
* Identify and resolve bottlenecks, ensuring initiatives move from concept and approval to implementation.
* Build trusted relationships with senior MoRD officials and coordinate across ministries, state governments, public institutions, financial institutions and implementation partners.
* Prepare senior\-level engagements and translate discussions into clear decisions and follow\-up actions.
* Manage and mentor the MoRD PMU team, maintaining a high bar for rigour, ownership and execution.



  





**Qualifications and Skills** 



* 8–10 years of professional experience, ideally in management consulting, strategy, transformation, public policy, economic development or a similar problem\-solving environment.
* Demonstrated ability to own complex programs end\-to\-end, from problem definition and solution design through stakeholder alignment and implementation.
* Strong stakeholder\-management skills and the maturity to work with senior government officials, business leaders, financial institutions and experts.
* Strong quantitative skills and comfort working across policy, strategy and implementation.
* Entrepreneurial and comfortable working in an early\-stage organisation, with a strong interest in rural economic development and government\-led transformation.
* MBA or postgraduate degree from a leading institution is preferred, but not mandatory.

* Establish and maintain the approved project scope.
* Identify scope deviations during execution.
* Evaluate change requests from customers.

* Maintain Change Request / Change Order documentation.

* Define mitigation and contingency plans.
* Monitor technical, commercial, schedule and resource risks.

We are looking for an experienced and result\-oriented **AV Project Manager** to manage and deliver Audio\-Visual integration projects from project initiation through successful completion and handover.

The candidate will be responsible for **project planning, client coordination, technical execution, manpower management, procurement coordination, project scheduling, quality control, testing \& commissioning, and final handover**.

Key Responsibilities1\. Project Planning \& Management

* Plan, schedule, execute, monitor, and close AV projects within agreed timelines.
* Understand project scope, specifications, BOQ, drawings, and client requirements.
* Prepare detailed project execution plans, schedules, and milestones.
* Allocate manpower, materials, tools, and other project resources.
* Monitor project progress and ensure timely completion.

2\. Client \& Stakeholder Management

* Act as the primary point of contact for clients during project execution.
* Coordinate with clients, consultants, architects, contractors, and other stakeholders.
* Conduct regular project review meetings and provide progress updates.
* Understand client requirements and manage project changes effectively.
* Resolve project\-related issues and escalations professionally.

3\. AV Project Execution

* Supervise complete AV system installation and integration.
* Coordinate installation of:
* LED/LCD/Interactive Displays
* Projectors and projection systems
* Professional audio systems
* Microphones and DSP systems
* Video conferencing systems
* Control systems
* Digital signage
* Room booking systems
* Matrix/Switching systems
* Structured AV cabling
* Video walls and collaboration solutions
* Ensure installation is carried out as per approved drawings, specifications, and industry standards.

4\. Team \& Subcontractor Management

* Manage AV engineers, technicians, programmers, and subcontractors.
* Allocate work and monitor daily site activities.
* Ensure proper utilization of manpower and resources.
* Coordinate with subcontractors and ensure quality and timely execution.
* Conduct regular site inspections.

5\. Procurement \& Material Coordination

* Coordinate with Procurement, Stores, and Vendors for project materials.
* Prepare and monitor material requirement schedules.
* Track material availability and delivery timelines.
* Ensure materials received at site match approved specifications.
* Minimize project delays caused by material shortages.

6\. Project Cost \& Commercial Control

* Monitor project budgets and expenses.
* Track project BOQ, variations, additional works, and change orders.
* Coordinate with the commercial/accounts team regarding project billing and documentation.
* Identify potential cost overruns and take corrective action.

7\. Testing \& Commissioning

* Coordinate system testing, commissioning, configuration, and troubleshooting.
* Ensure all AV systems are fully functional before client demonstration.
* Coordinate integration between AV, IT, networking, and control systems.
* Conduct client demonstrations and resolve commissioning issues.

8\. Quality \& Safety

* Ensure project execution meets company and client quality standards.
* Ensure proper installation practices and workmanship.
* Follow site safety procedures and ensure technicians/subcontractors comply with safety requirements.
* Conduct quality inspections and ensure timely closure of snags.

9\. Documentation \& Handover

* Maintain project documentation throughout the project lifecycle.
* Review and maintain:
* BOQ
* Project schedules
* Shop drawings
* As\-built drawings
* Installation checklists
* Testing \& commissioning reports
* Snag lists
* O\&M manuals
* Warranty documents
* Ensure complete project handover and obtain client sign\-off.

Required Technical Knowledge

The candidate should have good working knowledge of:

* Professional Audio \& Video Systems
* Video Conferencing Solutions
* Digital Signal Processors (DSP)
* Microphones and Audio Systems
* Projectors and Displays
* LED Walls / Video Walls
* AV over IP
* Matrix Switchers and Video Distribution
* Control Systems
* Digital Signage
* Room Automation
* Structured Cabling
* Network Fundamentals
* AV System Integration
* Testing \& Commissioning

Knowledge of platforms such as **Crestron, Extron, Biamp, QSC, Shure, Logitech, Cisco, Poly, Yealink, Barco, Samsung, LG** or similar AV technologies will be an added advantage.

Required Skills

* Strong project management and execution skills.
* Excellent client communication and coordination skills.
* Good leadership and team management abilities.
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Good knowledge of MS Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and project scheduling tools.
* Ability to read and understand AV drawings, schematics, and BOQs.
* Strong documentation and reporting skills.
* Willingness to travel to project sites as required.

Qualification \& Experience

**Education:**

* Diploma / Bachelor's Degree in Electronics, Electrical, IT, Networking, Engineering, or a related field.

**Experience:**

* 5–10 years of relevant experience in **AV System Integration / Audio Visual Projects / IT Infrastructure Projects**.
* Minimum 3–5 years of experience managing AV projects independently is preferred.
* Experience handling commercial, corporate, hospitality, education, government, or large\-scale AV projects will be an advantage.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Project completion within agreed timelines.
* Project execution within approved budget.
* Client satisfaction.
* Quality of installation and commissioning.
* Effective manpower utilization.
* Timely material coordination.
* Reduction in project delays and rework.
* Successful project handover and documentation.
* Timely closure of project snags.

Preferred Candidate Profile

We are looking for a **hands\-on AV Project Manager** who can independently manage projects, lead site teams, coordinate with clients and vendors, understand technical AV requirements, and ensure projects are delivered on time with the expected quality.

**KareXpert Overview:** 
  
 



 KareXpert Technologies is a Reliance Jio\-backed healthcare technology company offering an AI\-powered, cloud\-based Digital Healthcare Platform. With 60\+ integrated modules, including HIMS, EMR/EHR, Telemedicine, LIMS, RIS/PACS, Pharmacy, IoT, and Advanced Analytics, KareXpert enables hospitals to deliver connected, efficient, and patient\-centric care.

**Lead Digital Transformation in Healthcare** 

 Are you passionate about leveraging healthcare technology to transform hospital operations and improve patient care? Join KareXpert and lead large\-scale HIMS implementations across some of the region's leading healthcare institutions. From project kickoff to go\-live and stabilization, you will work closely with hospital leadership, clinical teams, and cross\-functional engineering teams to deliver impactful digital healthcare solutions.
 


**What You'll Do**

* Partner with Finance teams to monitor revenue realization, collections, project profitability, and commercial milestones.
* Drive process compliance, operational governance, and continuous improvement initiatives across projects.
* Lead change management initiatives to ensure smooth adoption of new clinical and operational workflows.


**Stakeholder \& Client Management** 
* Build strong relationships with hospital CXOs, clinical leadership, IT teams, and operational stakeholders.
* Serve as the primary escalation point for project\-related issues and ensure timely resolution.
* Conduct executive presentations, business reviews, and program status updates for senior leadership.
* Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction through proactive engagement and transparent communication.


**People Leadership** 
* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of 10\+ professionals across implementation, clinical, training, and technical functions.
* Drive team performance, capability development, and succession planning.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and customer\-centric delivery.


**Technical \& Solution Leadership** 
* Possess strong hands\-on knowledge of Hospital Information Management Systems (HIMS) and healthcare workflows.
* Lead solution discussions, implementation planning, and technical workshops with customers.
* Drive system configuration, workflow validation, training, testing, go\-live, and post\-go\-live support activities.
* Act as a subject matter expert and mentor team members on HIMS modules and implementation best practices.
* Ensure seamless integration of HIMS with third\-party healthcare and enterprise systems.


**Travel \& Deployment** 
* Be available for onsite engagement as required by business and project needs.
* Demonstrate flexibility and enthusiasm for extensive travel, including local, domestic, and international assignments.


**What You Bring** 
* MBA (Healthcare) / B.Tech (Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics) / MCA.
* 5–8 years of experience in Healthcare IT and HIMS implementation.
* Proven experience managing large\-scale healthcare implementation programs.
* Successful track record of implementing solutions for multi\-chain hospital groups or hospitals with 500\+ beds.
* Strong understanding of hospital operations, clinical workflows, and post\-go\-live support processes.
* Demonstrated experience in managing SteerCo meetings, executive stakeholders, escalations, and project governance.
* Proven experience leading and managing teams of 10 or more professionals.
* Excellent communication, presentation, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.
* Ability to thrive in fast\-paced environments, make decisions under ambiguity, and drive outcomes.


**Nice to Have** 
* PMP (Project Management Professional)
* PgMP (Program Management Professional)
* PRINCE2 Practitioner
* Agile / Scrum Certifications
* Healthcare Informatics or Digital Health Certifications


**Why Join KareXpert?** 
* Drive meaningful digital transformation across leading healthcare organizations.
* Own high\-impact projects from strategy to execution and see your work directly improve healthcare delivery.
* Work closely with senior leadership and gain exposure to large\-scale healthcare technology programs.
* Lead diverse teams, manage key customer relationships, and accelerate your career in healthcare technology leadership.
* Opportunity to work on challenging projects across India and international markets.


**Location** 

**Bangalore / Hyderabad**

* English – Fluent (Speaking, Reading, and Writing) – Mandatory

 We combine AI, IoT, intelligent sensors, drones, computer vision and digital platforms to turn farms into data\-driven, climate\-resilient and commercially stronger enterprises.
 





 We are looking for a highly driven Project Manager who can bring structure to ambiguity, align multidisciplinary teams, and turn ambitious ideas into reliable, scalable outcomes.
 



**The Role** 


 As Project Manager, you will own the end\-to\-end execution of Revin’s digital product and hardware product initiatives.
 





 You will coordinate across software, hardware, product, agronomy, field operations, customers, and leadership to ensure that every project moves from planning to deployment with clarity, speed, and accountability.
 





 This is not a traditional coordination role. We are looking for someone who can think like an owner, anticipate problems, make informed decisions, and build the execution systems required for a growing startup.
 



**What You’ll Own** 
**Project Planning and Delivery (Agile)** 
* Plan and manage projects from start to completion.
* Set clear responsibilities, timelines, and expected outcomes.
* Ensure projects are delivered on time and to the required quality.
* Keep teams focused on priorities and follow up until tasks are completed.


**Team Coordination** 
* Coordinate effectively across product, technology, field, and business teams.
* Ensure everyone understands what needs to be done, by whom, and by when.
* Conduct regular project meetings and maintain clear action points.
* Build accountability without unnecessary micromanagement.


**Day\-to\-Day Execution** 
* Lead sprint planning, team reviews, and regular progress discussions.
* Track deliverables, pending actions, risks, and dependencies.
* Identify delays early and take corrective action.
* Bring structure and clarity when priorities or requirements change.


**Stakeholder Communication** 
* Act as the primary point of contact for project\-related communication.
* Provide clear and timely updates to leadership, customers, and partners.
* Understand stakeholder expectations and convert them into actionable plans.
* Communicate challenges honestly, along with practical solutions.


**Deployment and Customer Success** 
* Coordinate product testing, customer deployment, training, and follow\-up.
* Ensure teams are prepared before every customer delivery or field implementation.
* Collect customer feedback and work with internal teams to address concerns.
* Ensure successful completion instead of treating deployment as the final step.


**Process Improvement** 
* Create simple systems for planning, documentation, reporting, and follow\-ups.
* Identify gaps and improve the way projects are executed.
* Reduce last\-minute confusion through better preparation and communication.
* Build processes that can support Revin as the company grows.

* **A Clear and Confident Communicator**
* **A Strong Team Coordinator**
* **An Organised and Accountable Professional**

 in project management, product operations, technical programme management, or startup execution.

* Direct opportunity to contribute to measurable impact in agriculture.

 Office Leadership

 Agriplast is scaling rapidly across domestic and international markets and is building out a strong project execution function to match. We are looking for a seasoned project leader to own the complete execution agenda from order handover and site mobilization through installation, commissioning, and client sign\-off across all project sites.

**1\. Project Strategy \& Planning** 




 •     Develop and execute the overall project execution strategy for domestic and international sites.
 



 •     Build detailed project plans, timelines, and resource/manpower deployment plans for each site.
 



**2\. Installation \& Project Execution** 




 •     Own end\-to\-end installation and commissioning of Polyhouses, Greenhouses, Net Houses and Poly tunnels at client sites.
 



 •     Ensure timely closure and handover of all critical and strategic projects within scope, budget and quality.
 



**3\. Vendor, Contractor \& Site Team Management**

**4\. Quality, Safety \& Standards**

 •     Project Completion Rate (On\-Time)
 



 •     Installation Cycle Time (Order to Handover)
 



 •     Cost Variance / Budget Adherence
 



 •     Client Satisfaction / Handover Score
 



 •     Site Safety Incident Rate
 



 •     Quality Rework Rate
 



 •     Resource \& Equipment Utilization Rate

 •     Experience: 12\+ years in project execution/installation management, including substantial time in a senior/leadership role, ideally in greenhouse, structural steel, construction, infrastructure or EPC project execution.
 



 •     Execution Track Record: Proven track record delivering large\-scale, multi\-site installation/construction projects on time, on budget and to quality standards.
 



 •     Vendor \& Contractor Management: Strong network and hands\-on experience managing multi\-site contractor, civil and labour teams.

description:

 Job Description: Conversion SME (Manager)
   

  

**Position Title:** 
 Manager – Conversion Subject Matter Expert (Life Insurance \& Annuities Policy Administration Transformation)
   

  

**Function:** 
 Insurance
   

  

**Location:** 
 Bangalore / Chennai / Coimbatore / Kochi / Kolkata / Noida /Hyderabad / Pune / Trivandrum
   

  

 Role Summary
   

  

 The Conversion SME will own the end\-to\-end data and policy conversion strategy for a Life \& Annuities policy administration system transformation (e.g., legacy platform to FAST/Majesco/OIPA/FINEOS target). This role bridges business, actuarial, and technical teams to ensure accurate, compliant, and auditable migration of in\-force policy data, values, and transaction history from source to target systems.
   

  

 Key Roles \& Responsibilities
   

  

**Conversion Strategy \& Governance**
* Define the end\-to\-end conversion approach: crosswalk methodology, data mapping standards, tolerance thresholds, and reconciliation framework between legacy and target platforms.
* Own the conversion playbook — cutover strategy (big\-bang vs. phased/wave\-based), fallback/rollback plans, and freeze\-period governance.
* Establish data lineage documentation and version\-controlled mapping specs for audit and regulatory traceability.


**Business \& Technical Bridge**
* Translate legacy policy administration rules (billing, values, riders, beneficiaries, agent/commission structures) into target system configuration requirements.
* Partner with actuarial, IT, and QA teams to validate converted policy values (cash value, reserves, death benefit, surrender values) against source\-of\-truth calculations.
* Lead root\-cause analysis on conversion breaks/exceptions and drive remediation with configuration or ETL teams.


**Data Mapping \& Rules Definition**
* Author functional specifications for field\-level, transaction\-level, and history conversion (policy, billing, claims\-in\-progress, agent/commission, correspondence).
* Define exception handling rules for non\-standard policies, riders, or legacy product variants that don't map cleanly to the target chart of accounts/product model.
* Validate mapping specs with source system SMEs and target platform configuration leads.


**Testing \& Reconciliation**
* Design and oversee conversion test cycles (mock conversions, parallel runs, dress rehearsals) and define pass/fail acceptance criteria.
* Own policy\-level and aggregate\-level reconciliation reporting (financial tie\-outs, record counts, value tolerances) presented to governance/steering forums.
* Sign off on conversion readiness gates ahead of each cutover wave.


**Team \& Stakeholder Management**
* Lead and mentor a pod of conversion analysts/testers (onshore/offshore); manage workload, quality, and delivery timelines.
* Act as primary conversion point of contact for client business owners, actuarial, compliance, and IT conversion teams.
* Present conversion status, risk, and exception dashboards to steering committee/PMO.


**Compliance \& Risk**
* Ensure conversion approach aligns with regulatory requirements (state filings, policyholder notification rules, NAIC/IFRS 17 where applicable).
* Maintain audit trail documentation sufficient for internal audit and regulatory examination.


 Must\-Have Skills
   

  

**Category**
**Requirement**
**Domain**
 9
   

  

**Platform**
 Hands\-on conversion experience on at least one target PAS: FAST, Majesco, OIPA, FINEOS, or equivalent legacy modernization platform
   

  

**Conversion\-specific**
 Prior experience in at least one full PAS conversion/migration cycle — mapping, mock conversions, parallel testing, cutover
   

  

**Data**
 Strong SQL skills; experience with data mapping/ETL concepts; policy value reconciliation (cash value, reserves, COI, fund values for annuities)
   

  

**Documentation**
 Ability to write field\-level functional specs, mapping documents, and test scripts to consulting\-grade standards
   

  

**Delivery**
 Experience managing a pod, sprint/wave\-based delivery, and reporting into a governance/PMO structure
   

  

**Regulatory**
 Familiarity with state insurance regulations, policyholder notification requirements, and IFRS 17/statutory reporting impacts on conversion
   

  

**Preferred Skills**
* Prior Big 4/IT Service Company or systems integrator consulting background
* Experience with both Life and Annuities product lines (not just one)
* Exposure to agile delivery frameworks (Scrum/SAFe) in a conversion pod context
* Group Benefits conversion exposure (cross\-domain flexibility)
* Vendor\-side experience (e.g., having worked at a FAST/Majesco/FINEOS implementation partner)


**Credentials/Certifications (Preferred, Not Mandatory)**
* LOMA certifications relevant to conversion/operations
* CSPO® / PMP® / Prosci (change management) for delivery\-side credibility
* Platform\-specific certifications (FAST, Majesco, FINEOS) where available


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

title: Project Manager
description:
Position Title: Project Manager
 



 Department: Project Management / Execution
 



 Reports To: Head – Projects / COO
 



 Location: Chennai
 



  





**Role Summary** 




 The Project Manager is responsible for end‑to‑end project planning, execution, monitoring, control, and closure, ensuring timely delivery, quality compliance, safety adherence, and cost control. The role requires strong leadership, cross‑functional coordination, client management, and the ability to manage multiple teams and subcontractors.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Project Planning \& Initiation** 




 \- Develop comprehensive project execution plans, schedules, and budgets.
 



 \- Review engineering designs, BOQ, drawings, and technical specifications.
 



 \- Identify project risks and prepare mitigation plans.
 



 \- Coordinate with engineering, procurement, construction, and finance teams.
 



  





**Project Execution \& Monitoring** 




 \- Lead the execution of all project phases to meet timelines and quality standards.
 



 \- Monitor progress using MSP/Primavera and ensure adherence to baseline schedules.
 



 \- Conduct regular review meetings with site teams and contractors.
 



 \- Resolve site bottlenecks and ensure smooth project flow.
 



  





**Contractor \& Resource Management** 




 \- Finalize work packages, contractor scopes, and resource allocation.
 



 \- Oversee contractor performance, productivity, and compliance.
 



 \- Verify work measurements, certifications, and billing.
 



  





**Quality \& Compliance** 




 \- Ensure adherence to QAP, ITP, and company quality standards.
 



 \- Conduct quality audits, inspections, and review NCRs with corrective actions.
 



 \- Ensure compliance with technical specifications and statutory requirements.
 



  





**Health, Safety \& Environment (HSE)** 




 \- Enforce HSE standards across site operations.
 



 \- Ensure site safety plan implementation and regular audits.
 



 \- Promote a strong safety culture through toolbox talks and training.
 



  





**Commercial \& Cost Control** 




 \- Manage project budgets, cash flow, and material consumption.
 



 \- Identify cost‑saving opportunities and prevent cost overruns.
 



 \- Support procurement in vendor finalization and technical evaluations.
 



  





**Client \& Stakeholder Management** 




 \- Act as the single point of contact for clients, consultants, and authorities.
 



 \- Conduct progress review meetings and manage approvals.
 



 \- Handle escalations and ensure high client satisfaction.
 



  





**Reporting \& Documentation** 




 \- Prepare daily/weekly/monthly progress reports and MIS.
 



 \- Maintain project documentation, contracts, and communication logs.
 



 \- Support management with dashboards, presentations, and closure reports.
 



  





**Required Qualifications \& Skills** 




  





**Educational Qualification** 




 \- Bachelor’s Degree in Civil/Electrical/Mechanical Engineering.
 



 \- PMP / PRINCE2 certification preferred (optional).
 



  





**Experience** 




 \- 10–20 years of experience in project management.
 



 \- Experience in Solar EPC / Industrial / Infrastructure / Power projects.
 



  





**Technical Skills** 




 \- Expertise in MS Project or Primavera.
 



 \- Strong understanding of engineering designs, drawings, and construction practices.
 



 \- Knowledge of QA/QC standards, contracts, and safety norms.
 



 \- Strong commercial and project costing knowledge.
 



  





**Behavioral Skills** 




 \- Excellent leadership and decision‑making capabilities.
 



 \- Strong interpersonal, negotiation, and communication skills.
 



 \- Ability to manage multi‑disciplinary teams.
 



 \- High adaptability and problem‑solving mindset.
 



  





 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
 



 \- On‑time project delivery
 



 \- Budget adherence and cost control
 



 \- Quality compliance and minimal rework
 



 \- HSE performance and zero‑incident record
 



 \- Client satisfaction and approvals
 



 \- Contractor performance and productivity
 



 \- Documentation accuracy and timely reporting

 projects—guiding teams in each phase to achieve outcomes that exceed clients’
   

  

 expectations and meet JLL’s commercial objectives. Driven and ambitious by nature, you
   

  

 have a mastery of the ins and outs of business—from products and systems to processes,
   

  

 tools and best practices. You’ll need to collaborate effectively with a range of stakeholders,
   

  

 leading from the front while also taking the time to understand their point of view.
   

  

 For each project, you’ll establish an effective organisational structure for reporting,
   

  

 communication and working procedures, and ensure that clear objectives and quality
   

  

 control systems are in place. You’ll lead a project team that is highly motivated, eager to
   

  

 contribute, and in sync with the stakeholders’ mind\-sets. You’ll also attend project
   

  

 meetings, submit monthly reports, and monitor project budgets, so an eye for detail and a

 Making clients our first priority
   

  

 The best person for this job is one who always considers what’s best for our clients. As
   

  

 such, you’ll maintain a strong and positive relationship with our clients by identifying
   

  

 their needs, requirements and constraints. While you act in the clients’ best interests
   

  

 throughout the project duration, you must make sure that the project’s revenue and
   

  

 payment cycles are properly managed.

 have a knack for building rapport with prospects? Your expertise in surveying a client’s
   

  

 needs and supporting the preparation of PM proposals is key. Likewise, skilfully
   

  

 developing relationships with other company business lines is a must; we achieve are
   

  

 biggest success when working together, so clear communication is key, as is
   

  

 collaboration and team work.
   

  

 Maintaining the JLL legacy
   

  

 We uphold excellence in everything we do—that has been essential to our more than 200
   

  

 years of staying power. As the person in charge, your task is to continue our tradition of
   

  

 project success. You’ll accomplish this by creating a network of professional consultants
   

  

**Who Can Deliver The Required Scope Of Every Project.**

 interests. Your expertise will also be central in identifying project risks and mitigating
   

  

 them. Furthermore, you’ll be responsible for developing project\-related reports, analyses
   

  

 and reviews regularly.
   

  

 Sound like you?
   

  

 Our successful Project Managers ...
   

  

 Engage confidently with internal and external stakeholders and see things from their
   

  

 perspective.

 Bring a structured and organised approach to everything they do.
   

  

 Communicate and collaborate to achieve success.
   

  

 Thrive under pressure and deal effectively with tight deadlines and high expectations.

 Project\-smart and technology\-savvy
   

  

 We employ talent from a wide range of backgrounds, though typically you should have a
   

  

 degree in any property\-related discipline, and at least 10 to 12 years’ experience in
   

  

 design, construction or project management.
   

  

 Are you technology savvy? As the digital leader in project management, we use a range
   

  

 of technology platforms to deliver our projects.
   

  

 Do you have a deep understanding of the legal environment for each project in respect to
   

  

 planning, commercial aspects, and delivery? If your answers are ‘yes’, then you’re already

 A natural communicator
   

  

 This role calls for superior communication skills, as we’ll expect you to be able to handle
   

  

 complex conversations with business owners, senior executives, and decision makers. We

 times. Of course, you’ll be good at building team relationships and interacting effectively

 What we can do for you:
   

  

 At JLL, our purpose is to shape the future of real estate for a better world.

title: Director, Project Management
description:
Azurity Pharmaceuticals is a privately held, specialty pharmaceutical company that focuses on innovative products that meet the needs of underserved patients. As an industry leader in providing unique, accessible, and high\-quality medications, Azurity leverages its integrated capabilities and vast partner network to continually expand its broad commercial product portfolio and robust late\-stage pipeline. The company’s patient\-centric products span the cardiovascular, neurology, endocrinology, gastro\-intestinal, institutional, and orphan markets, and have benefited millions of patients. For more information, visit www.azurity.com.
   

  

 Azurity Pharmaceuticals is proud to be an inclusive workplace and an Equal Opportunity Employer. Azurity's success is attributable to our incredibly talented, dedicated team that focuses on benefiting the lives of patients by bringing the best science and commitment to quality into everything that we do. We seek highly motivated individuals with the dedication, integrity, and creative spirit needed to thrive in our organization.
   

  

**Brief Team/department Description**
 Azurity develops unique, accessible, and high\-quality medications, to serve overlooked patients. This role is with Azurity R\&D project management team, which coordinates cross\-functional planning, development and tracking of project plans, considering time, cost, quality and strategy. As we grow and expand, we are building new capabilities to make our processes simpler, faster, and more efficient. We are looking for a dynamic, change\-inspired leader, to lead R\&D project management, and process improvement initiatives.
   

  

 This role will report to the R\&D head and act as an internal consultant operating from Azurity’s Hyderabad development center. The role holder provides input on resource (budget, headcount) strategy and support in setting the yearly product delivery KPI. This role will be responsible for managing the R\&D Project Management department, defining, and implementing R\&D Project Management processes. Holds the overall responsibility in the R\&D PM team for ensuring Project Plans, Budgets, Timelines are tracked against baseline and updated as per the Program Management process. Ensure project plan alignment with portfolio and product lifecycle management (PLM) goals.
   

  

 The role holder will lead cross\-functional initiatives to enhance R\&D productivity and streamline product development processes through targeted process improvements, tool evaluation, and vendor coordination. This role acts as the functional lead to ensure that technology\-enabled solutions align closely with evolving R\&D needs, leveraging a strong working knowledge of pharmaceutical R\&D workflows, data and applicable concepts to effectively coordinate with external vendors, internal data science and digital teams. This role focuses on functional leadership and facilitation, responsible for working with the Chief Scientific Officer and science department heads to ensure streamlined processes are in place for meeting yearly KPIs, identifying process improvement \& simplification opportunities.
   

  

 The scope includes financial governance, reporting, resource planning, and process improvement. An ideal candidate will have experience with leading complex programs within the pharmaceutical development lifecycle, in addition to experience with CMO/CRO/lab operations. A deep understanding of project plans, budgeting / forecasting is a key attribute. This is a collaborative role involving significant engagement with cross\-functional heads (such as Quality, finance, accounting, legal and IT), to drive programs and ensure adoption. This role will have the exciting and unique opportunity to drive Management System excellence and adoption within our growing Hyderabad organization. The ideal candidate will be a quick learner who can work in an extremely fast paced organization and pivot from one objective to the next quickly.
   

  

**Principle Responsibilities**
* A) Lead project management
* Enable preparation and management of CSO\-R\&D budget, yearly KPIs and project plans. Enable project managers to identify, document and manage critical path activities. Review project plans, challenge project schedule baseline and assumptions. Ensure project managers have defined all activities with appropriate timelines, costs, risks and mitigation plans aligned with the project stakeholders.
* Through the project managers, prepare month\-on\-month project forecasts and manage CSO\-level variance between forecast vs. actual within thresholds. Facilitate budget decisions and deliverables throughout the yearly cycle. Support the R\&D head and science department heads in articulating decisions required, risks and layout options at appropriate level of depth to enable decisions.
* Enable project plan updation in A3 templates for all projects. Support the Franchise Portfolio Management and finance leadership with timeline, and cost evaluations when requested. Responsible for project status reporting to R\&D scientific leadership team (SLT), Strategic Portfolio Management and other project stakeholders as required. Maintain management information systems on budget, timelines, key risks, and decisions.
* Partner with the finance leadership and co\-own the Long\-Range Budget forecast, responsible for R\&D opex, capex, and product\-level development cost. Align science department leadership on the stage\-wise Probability of Technical \& Regulatory success.
* B) Management systems \& processes:
* Continuously improve the contract and purchase order (PO) management process for R\&D, through a periodic review of SLA and goals with the legal and finance teams Facilitate regular and ad hoc project team meetings, ensuring documentation of agendas, minutes, and actions. Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (internal/external) to track key performance indicators
* Develop/maintain collaboration and nurture relationships with internal partner functions and external entities as required, to support business and strategic goals. Serve as the point person for initial escalation, conflict resolution, project risk mitigation for issues that cannot be resolved in the Project Teams, requiring liaising with department leaders
* Oversight, mentoring, training of PM team members on policies and procedures
* Support R\&D operational planning \- Lab space management, capex \& support internal preparedness for QA audits, leadership visits.
* Responsible for drafting the R\&D sections in management presentations, working with the department heads and the Chief Scientific Officer.
* C) Digital enablement initiatives:
* Lead a small team of PMs and manage the R\&D digital budget, including annual subscriptions for off\-the\-shelf solutions as well as custom built solutions (external as well as in\-house).
* Champion the evaluation of cutting\-edge data tools and data\-enabled solutions by working alongside internal digital, data science and technical teams to ensure deliverables meeting R\&D’s strategic goals
* Lead end\-to\-end digital transformations from vendor selection to rollout, engaging with IT, cross functional teams and external vendors. Wherever optimal, lead in\-house workflow creation and execution through the IT team.
* Serve as the internal business owner to the Azurity IT team, on R\&D / laboratory systems such as E\-Lab Notebook, Document mgmt. system. Drive functional oversight on integration projects involving lab systems, ensuring alignment with R\&D workflows
* Build and manage vendor relationships through screening, onboarding and on\-premises engagements. Define and monitor service expectations from external vendors via functionally aligned SLAs based on R\&D user needs. Provide continuous feedback to vendors to ensure tools evolve with R\&D processes, without taking direct ownership of the digital systems


**Qualifications/Educational Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in Pharmacy, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Life Sciences, Chemistry, Biotechnology, Engineering, or a related scientific discipline.
* Master's degree preferred:
* MBA (Strategy, Operations, General Management, or Finance)
* MS/M.Pharm in a relevant scientific field
* Certifications (preferred, not mandatory)
* PMP
* PgMP
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt/Black Belt


**Preferred Experience**
 15\-20 years of pharmaceutical industry experience, including:
   

  

**Project and Portfolio Management**
* At least 7\-10 years managing cross\-functional development programs.
* Experience with R\&D portfolios rather than isolated projects.
* Experience leading governance meetings and stage\-gate reviews.


**Budget Management**
* Ownership or co\-ownership of departmental budgets.
* Experience reviewing forecasts prepared by analysts or PMs.
* Experience presenting budget updates to senior leadership.


**Process and Organizational Change**
* Designing new departmental processes.
* Simplifying complex workflows.
* Implementing systems such as Veeva, TrackWise, Planisware, Smartsheet, Clarity, Microsoft Project, etc.
* Creating governance models and decision\-making frameworks.
* Driving organizational adoption of new ways of working.


 By applying for this role, you confirm that you are mentally and physically capable of fulfilling the job responsibilities detailed in the job description without any restrictions. If you have any concerns or even the slightest disability that may affect your ability to perform the job, please inform HR in advance.

* Excellent communication and stakeholder\-management skills
* Ability to manage multiple activities and priorities
* Strong follow\-up and problem\-solving skills
* Good knowledge of construction practices and project controls
* Ability to work under pressure and meet project deadlines

Established in 2004, **OLIVER** is the world's first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in\-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. We partner with over 300 clients in 40\+ countries and counting. Our unique model drives creativity and efficiency, allowing us to deliver tailored solutions that resonate deeply with audiences.



As a part of **The Brandtech Group**, we're at the forefront of leveraging cutting\-edge AI technology to revolutionise how we create and deliver work. Our **AI solutions** enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision\-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results.

**Role:** Project Manager


**Location:** Mumbai, India

  


**About the role:**



The Project Manager supports Designers in running the projects across the teams with focus on consistent delivery \&providing effective solutions to the client and team when needed. They are responsible for liaising within the Client and Designers to ensure all projects are completed in time. The candidate will be responsible for all projects briefed by the client, working with the creative teams or other teams in the region.

  


**What you will be doing:**


* To work actively with all internal and external stakeholders to ensure the delivery of the highest level of project quality and client service from all teams.
* To assist in brief writing and generate necessary admin work, to ensure creative team in the regional creative hub can start work on time.
* To manage the work of creatives to ensure OLIVER's processes are followed, project timelines are met, driving maximum efficiency, productivity and the maintenance of the highest quality of creative concept, design and artwork.
* Manage and coordinate the sharing of brand and campaign knowledge pertaining to the project within the team to aid the development of creative ideas for the project.
* To ensure the client experience is as positive as possible using clear communication in person, through the telephone and supported by email.
* To manage the timely delivery of all jobs / projects going through the team, always taking into consideration the clients requirements and expectations.
* To cover all reporting responsibilities, including consolidation of each local market MI report and final reporting to the Regional Client
* To review and improve ways of working across markets
* To understand \& adhere to the clients way of working

  


**What you need to be great in this role:**


* Excellent client management skills with the ability to proactively organise and discuss project related matters with Client, addressing client queries effectively and in a timely manner
* The ability to manage and filter workflow as well as organise workloads to maximise productivity.
* Knowledge of the streaming platform itself along with digital ecosystem/platforms best practices and clear idea of how digital tools and technologies add value to the project.
* Highly resourceful \& a fast learner with the ability to share interesting brand or project\-related references to contribute to project output.
* Stay up\-to\-date with In\-depth understanding of marketing technology, digital media and social media platforms.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills and strong presentation abilities.
* Strong listening skills and the ability to be open to new ideas from team members, coworkers, industry sources and clients.
* Ability to oversee and lead several projects at once.
* A source of innovation, passion and creative vision
* Self\-motivated, working with little supervision.
* Collaborative team player, open minded – non\-political.
* Proven ability to communicate and liaise with junior \- mid levels in the business.
* Discrete about all confidential and personal information.
* Driven, proactive, helpful, and enthusiastic team player.

\#LI\-Onsite \#LI\-JQ1

Be **Ambitious** to succeed



Be **Imaginative** to push the boundaries of what's possible

description:

possible for the customers and communities we serve globally. With a dedicated, diverse and
professional team of more than 111,000 employees from 159 nationalities, spanning 77 countries on six
continents, DP World is pushing trade further and faster towards a seamless supply chain that’s fit for
the future. We’re rapidly transforming and integrating our businesses \- Ports and Terminals, Marine

stronger, more efficient end\-to\-end supply chain solutions that can change the way the world trades.
What's more, we're reshaping the future by investing in innovation. From intelligent delivery systems

technology milestones.

title: Senior Project lead
description:
**Project Manager \- MEP**
**Project and Development Services**
**What this job involves:**
**Pillar of the team**
 Working closely with either the project manager or the senior project manager (or both), you’ll play a pivotal role in driving project success.  We live and breathe client satisfaction. Thus, we need someone who share the same passion and dedication. You’ll maintain a strong and positive relationship with our clients by identifying their needs, requirements and constraints.

 For over 200 years, JLL has become synonymous with project success—you will help continue this history of excellence.
