You will also help identify project risks and implement measures to mitigate them. Furthermore, you will create project\-related reports, analyses and reviews.
   

  

**Sound like you? To apply you need to be:**
**An expert in the field**
 Do you have a degree in any property\-related discipline? How about at least Five years of experience in Planning, documentation, design, construction or project management? If yes, we’re keen to discuss with you.
   

  

**An empowering colleague**
 In this role, you’ll work with people of different ranks and responsibilities—that is why the ideal candidate is expected to promote open, constructive and collaborative relations with superiors, subordinates, peers and clients. Likewise, you’ll strive to gain the respect of JLL staff, clients and the broader business community.
   

  

**What we can do for you:**
 At JLL, we make sure that you become the best version of yourself by helping you realise your full potential in an entrepreneurial and inclusive work environment. We will empower your ambitions through our dedicated Total Rewards Program, competitive pay and benefits package.
   

  

 Apply today !

title: Senior Technical Project Manager - India
description:
**We're looking for a** 
****Senior Technical Project Manager \- India****
**This role is** 
**Office Based, Pune Office**
**Senior Technical Project Manager**
**About The Role**
 We're looking for a
 **Senior Technical Project Manager** 
 to drive the planning and delivery of our product roadmap. You'll sit at the intersection of Product, Engineering, and Customers turning strategic priorities into well\-sequenced execution plans, keeping releases on track, and giving leadership clear visibility into progress and risk. This is a high\-impact role for someone who thrives on structure, loves solving cross\-team coordination problems, and wants their work to directly shape what ships.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own end\-to\-end planning and delivery for major product initiatives, from roadmap intake through release and post\-release review.
* Partner with Product Managers and Engineering Leads to translate roadmap priorities into scoped, sequenced execution plans.
* Manage sprint/release cadences across multiple engineering pods, ensuring dependencies are identified and resolved early.
* Run core agile ceremonies (sprint planning, backlog grooming, retros) and continuously tune process to the team's needs.
* Track and report progress against the roadmap — timelines, scope changes, risks — to engineering leadership and executive stakeholders.
* Work with the customers to ensure we’re meeting the customer timelines.
* Coordinate cross\-functional readiness for releases (QA, Design, Docs, Support, Customer facing teams) so releases land smoothly.
* Maintain a single source of truth for project status, RAID logs, and release plans.
* Identify systemic bottlenecks in the delivery pipeline and drive process improvements across Product/Eng.
* Manage multiple concurrent workstreams without losing sight of the bigger product strategy.


**What You'll Bring**
* 6–8 years of technical project/program management experience, ideally within a product company (SaaS or platform business).
* Strong grasp of Agile/Scrum and modern product development practices; comfortable working directly with engineers on technical tradeoffs.
* Experience managing roadmap\-to\-release delivery, not just project execution — you understand product lifecycle, not just task tracking.
* Skilled with tools like Jira, Linear, Asana, Confluence, or similar.
* Excellent communicator who can flex between engineering detail and executive\-level summaries.
* Track record of managing multiple concurrent product workstreams in a fast\-moving environment.
* PMP, CSM, or SAFe certification a plus.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience) and MBA.


**Nice to Have**
* Experience in enterprise SaaS or B2B platform companies.
* Familiarity with release management, feature flagging, and phased rollout practices.
* Exposure to customer\-facing launches or GA (general availability) processes


**Our Culture**
 Spark Greatness. Shatter Boundaries. Share Success. Are you ready? Because here, right now – is where the future of work is happening. Where curious disruptors and change innovators like you are helping communities and customers enable everyone – anywhere – to learn, grow and advance. To be better tomorrow than they are today.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 At Cornerstone, we believe in AI that works in the service of people, amplifying their judgment to drive high\-performing, future\-ready organizations forward. Cornerstone Workforce AI™, the intelligence platform for workforce readiness, brings together workforce and labor market data into a proprietary Cornerstone People Graph™, translating signals into intelligence, targeting learning where it matters, developing critical skills, and surfacing hidden talent. Delivered as an open, enterprise platform across whatever application your people work in every day, Cornerstone Workforce AI is built for scale, security, and trust, with certified AI guardrails. As an industry leader, Cornerstone is helping approximately 7,000 organizations, 140M\+ users, across 186 countries build continuous workforce readiness.

 3

description:
**RFP Delivery Manager** 




  





**AArete is one\-of\-a\-kind when it comes to consulting firm culture.** 









 We’re a global, innovative management and technology consulting firm with offices in the U.S. and India. Our name comes from the Greek word for excellence: “Areté.” And excellence is exactly what we strive for.
 



  





 We’re celebrating our fourth year as one of Forbes’
 *World’s Best Management Consulting Firms* 
 – and our success starts with our people. From robust career development planning to competitive life and wellness benefits, AArete’s “Culture of Care” takes a holistic approach to the employee experience.
 



  





 AAretians (our team members) are leaders at every level. You are encouraged to unlock your full potential by directly contributing to our mission and prioritizing personal development and fulfillment.
 



  





**The Role** 




 The RFP Delivery Manager owns execution of AART’s RFP portfolio while serving as a strategic and writing partner to the Vice President. This role is accountable for end\-to\-end delivery, content quality, and day\-to\-day decision\-making across all pursuits.
 



 The role combines delivery leadership, healthcare and business acumen, writing ownership, and effective use of AI in the proposal process. It is not a coordination\-only role.
 



  





**Work You’ll Do** 




**RFP Delivery Ownership** 



* Lead RFPs from intake through submission
* Own schedules, compliance tracking, review cycles, and final quality control
* Act as the default decision\-maker on delivery\-related issues when the VP is unavailable



**Strategic Interpretation and Support** 



* Apply strong healthcare and general business acumen to interpret guidance from Managing Directors and senior SMEs
* Translate high\-level or ambiguous input into clear proposal positioning, structure, and direction
* Proactively identify strategy gaps, inconsistencies, or risks and elevate recommendations early



**Writing and Content Ownership** 



* Take direct writing ownership for proposal sections as needed, including executive summaries, approaches, and strategy\-heavy responses
* Edit and finalize content to ensure clarity, concision, and executive\-level quality
* Ensure consistency with AArete’s voice, POV, win themes, and differentiators



**AI\-Enabled Proposal Execution** 



* Use AI tools effectively to improve proposal speed, quality, and consistency
* Apply AI to accelerate drafting, synthesize SME input and prior material, and support compliance and redundancy checks
* Establish clear guardrails to ensure AI output is refined, validated, and elevated AArete’s natural, direct, non\-fluff voice
* Coach proposal team members on practical, responsible use of AI in proposal development



**Quality and Risk Management** 



* Enforce standards for clarity, consistency, and non\-redundancy across all submissions
* Identify and manage risks related to scope, resourcing, compliance, or narrative quality
* Resolve issues directly where possible; escalate selectively and with options



**Key Characteristics of this Role** 



* Combines execution ownership with strategic judgement
* Requires substantive writing and editing responsibility
* Acts as an operational deputy to the VP
* Uses AI for speed, efficiency, and effectiveness
* Other duties as assigned



  





**Requirements** 



* 12\+ Years of experience in proposal management, RFP leadership, business development, and executive communications
* High judgment, strong ownership mindset, and low need for oversight. Ability to think critically
* Strong healthcare domain knowledge (preferred but not absolutely required) and solid business acumen
* Experience leading complex RFPs with senior stakeholders
* Executive\-level writing and editing capability
* Demonstrated ability to synthesize ambiguous input into clear and differentiating responses
* Practical experience using AI in proposal development



  





**Benefits** 



* Flexible Paid Time Off of up to 23 days annually, in addition to 10 paid public holidays
* Hybrid work model with flexible in\-office attendance
* Comprehensive health benefits including medical insurance (Mediclaim), personal accident insurance, and term life insurance
* Generous paid parental leave program
* Attractive employee referral bonus scheme
* Transportation allowance and night shift allowance
* Employee advance salary loan facility
* Structured professional certification reimbursement policy to support ongoing learning and development



  





**We put humans at the center of our work** 




  





 We’re a global management and technology consulting firm specializing in strategic profitability improvement, digital transformation, and strategy \& change for clients. Our cross\-industry solutions are powered by a digital\-first mindset, market intelligence, and data\-driven approach to deliver purposeful change, actionable insights, and guaranteed results.
 



  





 But what sets us apart is our people. We are guided by our deeply embedded guiding principles: Excellence, Passion, Loyalty to Clients, Stewardship, Family, Community, Sustainability, and Inclusion.
 



  





 And we’ve been recognized as a top firm to work for by companies like Forbes, Top Workplaces Chicago Tribune, and Consulting Magazine.
 








 We’ve earned a Great Place to Work Certification™ and been named a World’s Best Management Consulting Firm by Forbes, Vault’s Top 50 Firms to Work For, Crain's Chicago Business Fast 50, Inc 5000’s Fastest Growing Firms, and Consulting Magazine's Fastest Growing Firms.

 Energy feeds on energy. If you flourish in a fast paced, results\-oriented environment, if you want to achieve individual success within a “team first” organization, and if you believe you can contribute and succeed in a demanding yet collegial atmosphere, then Lattice may well be just what you’re looking for.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Role Summary**
 The organization is seeking an experienced Staff\-level EDA / Software Operations Specialist to manage the end\-to\-end lifecycle of both EDA and enterprise software vendor engagements. This role serves as the primary liaison between engineering, procurement, finance, and legal functions to ensure that all vendor contracts, renewals, and purchase transactions are executed in a timely, compliant, and cost\-effective manner. Given the scale and complexity of the vendor portfolio, the role requires strong project management discipline to track hundreds of concurrent threads across contracts, approvals, and stakeholders, along with excellent communication skills to coordinate effectively across cross\-functional and often global teams.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Manage the complete lifecycle of EDA and Software vendor contracts, including new agreements, renewals, extensions, and terminations, across multiple vendors and tool categories.
* Track license utilization, renewal timelines, and contract expiry dates across a large and diverse vendor portfolio, proactively initiating renewal discussions to avoid business disruption.
* Raise and manage Purchase Requisitions (PRs) and Purchase Orders (POs) for EDA tools, software licenses, and related services, ensuring accuracy of commercial terms, quantities, and cost centers.
* Partner with Finance teams to obtain budget approvals, validate cost allocations, and ensure alignment with departmental and organizational budgets.
* Coordinate with Legal teams to route vendor contracts, Master Service Agreements (MSAs), Non\-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs), and amendments through the appropriate review and clearance process.
* Negotiate commercial terms, pricing structures, and licensing models with EDA and Software vendors in collaboration with sourcing/procurement stakeholders, where applicable.
* Apply strong project management practices to simultaneously track hundreds of active threads, spanning contract negotiations, approval workflows, renewal deadlines, and stakeholder follow\-ups, ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.
* Maintain accurate, well\-organized, and up\-to\-date records of all vendor contracts, license entitlements, renewal schedules, and approval documentation.
* Serve as the key point of contact for internal engineering, IT, and design teams regarding EDA and software license availability, tool access issues, and procurement status.
* Communicate proactively and clearly with stakeholders across Engineering, Finance, Legal, Procurement, and vendor\-side teams, providing regular status updates and escalating risks or delays in a timely manner.
* Support internal and external audits by ensuring proper documentation, license compliance, and adherence to organizational procurement policies.
* Identify opportunities for cost optimization, license right\-sizing, and consolidation across EDA and software vendor contracts.
* Prepare periodic reports and dashboards on vendor spend, renewal pipeline, and vendor performance for management review.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional stakeholders across geographies, given the global nature of EDA and software vendor relationships.


**Required Skills And Experience**
* 6 to 9 years of relevant experience in EDA Operations, Software Asset Management, IT Procurement, or a similar vendor/contract management function within a semiconductor or technology organization.
* Demonstrated experience working directly with EDA vendors and familiarity with common EDA licensing models (node\-locked, floating, term\-based licenses), as well as experience managing enterprise software vendor contracts.
* Strong understanding of procurement processes, including purchase requisition and purchase order workflows within enterprise systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Coupa, or similar).
* Working knowledge of contract lifecycle management, including experience coordinating with Legal teams on contract review and clearance.
* Experience partnering with Finance functions on budgeting, cost tracking, and invoice reconciliation.
* Strong project management skills, with proven ability to track and manage a high volume (hundreds) of parallel threads, deadlines, and stakeholder actions without losing accuracy or momentum.
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to clearly convey status, risks, and priorities to diverse stakeholders including senior management, vendors, and cross\-functional teams.
* Strong negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
* High attention to detail with strong organizational and documentation practices.
* Ability to manage multiple vendor renewals and deadlines simultaneously in a fast\-paced environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field. An advanced degree is a plus but not mandatory.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Prior experience specifically in a semiconductor design company or design services organization.
* Familiarity with license management tools (e.g., FlexLM/FlexNet) and license usage monitoring practices.
* Familiarity with project/task tracking tools (e.g., Jira, Smartsheet, MS Project, or similar) to manage high\-volume workstreams.
* Exposure to global vendor contract negotiations across multiple regions.
* Formal project management certification (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2\) is an added advantage.


**Additional Information**
 This position requires a successful background and reference checks and satisfactory proof of your right to work in:
   

  

 India
   

  

 Lattice recognizes that employees are its greatest asset and the driving force behind success in a highly competitive, global industry. Lattice continually strives to provide a comprehensive compensation and benefits program to attract, retain, motivate, reward and celebrate the highest caliber employees in the industry.
   

  

 Lattice is an international, service\-driven developer of innovative low cost, low power programmable design solutions. Our global workforce, some 1,000 strong, shares a total commitment to customer success and an unbending will to win. For more information about how our FPGA, CPLD and programmable power management devices help our customers unlock their innovation, visit www.latticesemi.com. You can also follow us via Twitter, Facebook, or RSS. At Lattice, we value the diversity of individuals, ideas, perspectives, insights and values, and what they bring to the workplace. Applications are welcome from all qualified candidates.

JOB SUMMARY

We are looking for an experienced and strategic **Chief Project Officer (CPO)** to provide overall leadership and governance for the Company's real estate project portfolio.

The CPO will be responsible for ensuring that all projects are delivered **within approved timelines, budgets, quality standards, specifications and regulatory requirements**. The role will oversee project planning, design coordination, approvals, procurement, construction, contracts, cost control, project monitoring and handover.

The CPO will work closely with the **MD/Directors, Design \& Planning, Projects, Contracts, Purchase, Accounts \& Finance, Legal, Liaisoning, Sales and CRM teams** to ensure seamless project execution and achievement of business objectives.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES1\. Project Portfolio Leadership

* Provide strategic leadership for all ongoing and upcoming real estate projects.
* Establish project execution strategy, milestones and delivery plans.
* Monitor overall portfolio performance and identify critical risks.
* Ensure alignment of project execution with the Company's business strategy.
* Conduct regular project review meetings with Project Heads and senior management.

2\. Project Planning \& Execution

* Oversee the complete project lifecycle from conceptualization to possession/handover.
* Review master schedules, construction programs and project milestones.
* Ensure timely commencement and completion of major project activities.
* Monitor progress against approved project schedules.
* Identify delays and implement corrective action plans.
* Ensure effective coordination between design, construction and commercial teams.

3\. Design \& Technical Coordination

* Coordinate with Design \& Planning teams for timely release of drawings and specifications.
* Ensure constructability and practicality of designs.
* Review major technical decisions affecting cost, quality and timelines.

* Coordinate with architects, consultants, structural engineers and MEP consultants.

4\. Construction Management

* Provide overall supervision and governance of construction activities.
* Monitor site progress through Project Managers, Construction Heads and Site Engineers.
* Ensure construction is executed according to approved drawings and specifications.
* Monitor manpower, machinery, materials and contractor productivity.
* Ensure adherence to construction schedules and quality standards.

5\. Cost Control \& Project Budget

* Ensure projects are executed within approved budgets.
* Monitor project cost against approved estimates and budgets.
* Review major variations, deviations and additional costs.
* Identify opportunities for cost optimization without compromising quality.
* Coordinate with Accounts, Purchase and Commercial teams on project expenditure.
* Monitor project profitability and financial performance.

6\. Contracts \& Procurement

* Work closely with Contracts and Purchase teams for timely appointment of contractors and vendors.
* Review major contracts, work orders and commercial terms.
* Monitor contractor performance and contractual obligations.
* Ensure timely procurement of critical materials and services.
* Resolve major contractor and vendor disputes in coordination with management and legal teams.

7\. Regulatory Approvals \& Liaisoning

* Coordinate with the Liaisoning and Legal teams to ensure timely statutory approvals.
* Monitor approvals, permissions, NOCs and regulatory requirements.
* Ensure projects remain compliant with applicable development regulations.
* Track critical approval dependencies affecting project timelines.

8\. Quality Management

* Establish and monitor project quality standards.
* Ensure compliance with approved specifications and construction standards.
* Review major quality issues and implement preventive measures.
* Ensure proper testing, inspections and documentation.
* Monitor snagging, rectification and final quality before handover.

9\. Risk Management

* Identify project risks related to:
* Cost
* Time
* Approvals
* Design
* Contractors
* Procurement
* Quality
* Resources
* Regulatory compliance
* Develop mitigation plans for critical project risks.
* Escalate major risks to the MD/Directors with recommended solutions.

10\. Project MIS \& Management Reporting

* Establish standardized project reporting systems.
* Review weekly and monthly project MIS.
* Present project status to the MD/Directors.
* Track:
* Planned vs. actual progress
* Project cost
* Budget variance
* Critical milestones
* Contractor performance
* Approval status
* Procurement status
* Quality issues
* Risk register
* Provide accurate forecasts for project completion.

11\. Team Leadership

* Lead and mentor Project Managers, Construction Heads, Engineers and project teams.
* Define responsibilities, authority levels and performance expectations.
* Build a high\-performance project management culture.
* Conduct periodic performance reviews of project leadership teams.
* Develop SOPs and standardized project execution processes.

12\. Handover \& Project Closure

* Ensure timely completion and handover of projects.
* Coordinate with CRM, Sales, Legal and Projects teams for possession readiness.
* Ensure completion documentation and statutory certificates are in place.
* Monitor snagging and defect rectification.
* Ensure proper project closure and post\-project review.

IDEAL CANDIDATE

The ideal candidate should be a **senior real estate project leader** who has successfully managed large project portfolios and can take complete ownership of **time, cost, quality, approvals and execution**.

description:
1. **About the Organisation**



 The Times of India is the flagship publication of Bennett, Coleman \& Co. Ltd. It is the world’s largest English broadsheet daily newspaper and covers a wide range of news interests like political, business, sports, entertainment, lifestyle, etc. TOI is built on the key principle to question conventional wisdom and present a comprehensive perspective to the reader for the news around us. The TOI Editorial function is the driving force behind the generation of content that shapes the reader experience. With a focus on news and analysis, this function constantly endeavours to implement path\-breaking ideas and drive value\-creation innovations.
 



  





**Role: Program Manager \- Big Tech Partnerships** 




  





**2\. Job Description** 




**Revenue, billing and Finance liaison** 



* Raise monthly invoices against partner POs and ROs, and make sure every signed line is billed.
* Track billed versus contracted value across all Big Tech deals, and flag anything that is slipping.
* Follow up on outstanding payments with the partner and with our collections and Finance teams until closure.
* Own the Big Tech payment tracker and the annual forecast.
* Reconcile partner marketing spends across TV, print and digital against the deal, campaign by campaign.
* Coordinate with Finance on POs, credit notes, GST and documentation so invoices are not held up.



**Project implementation and partner coordination** 



* Take every signed contract from signature to delivery list out the deliverables, get owners against each, and close them inside the contractual window.
* Run the implementation calls with the partner's team and with our internal teams (Editorial, Product, Ad Ops), and keep one live status view.
* Verify what has actually gone live before we call a deliverable complete, and keep the evidence on record for the partner.
* Chase the partner for PO release once contracts are signed.
* Escalate early where an internal dependency is going to miss a contractual date.



**Contract and documentation control** 



* Maintain the master record of all Big Tech contracts terms, dates, deliverables, renewal and exit dates.
* Circulate signed contracts, keep the file complete, and be the single reference point for what was agreed.
* Give the Big Tech Head and leadership a clear read on where each contract stands ahead of any partner discussion.



  





**Research and support to new business** 



* Pull together the data we need for partner discussions content, archive, audio\-video, Indic language and audience data.
* Track what other publishers are doing with AI \& Big Tech Companies, and what deal structures they are signing.
* Keep an eye on court proceedings and lawsuits filed by publishers globally.
* Build the decks, whitepapers and one\-pagers used in partner and internal meetings.
* Support new partner conversations (Meta, Microsoft and others) with background research and first\-cut commercial notes.



**3\. Who we are looking for** 




**Must have** 



* 2\+ years of experience in partnership operations, key account management, business operations or a client\-servicing role with commercial ownership.
* Hands\-on experience with billing and collections, raising invoices, working with POs, and following up on payments with clients and with internal Finance.
* Experience running delivery against contractual timelines, with both internal teams and an external client.
* Comfortable with numbers. Can build and maintain revenue trackers, reconciliations and forecasts
* Clean, professional written English.
* Deep understanding of AI tools and prompt engineering
* Graduate; MBA or equivalent preferred.



**Good to have** 



* Exposure to AI tools , media, publishing or digital content businesses.
* Prior work with a large technology or platform client (Google, Meta, Microsoft, OpenAI, Amazon or similar).
* Experience with contract documentation and commercial terms.
* Ability to build a decent deck without design support.

title: Professional, PDS Projects
description:
**What this job involves:**
 Directing projects every step of the way
   

  

 You’ll develop big ideas that will spark the effective management and successful execution of all phases of a project—from initiating to final handover to the client. You’ll need to carefully identify and take note of our clients’ needs, and figure out what exactly needs to be done in a way that meets JLL’s commercial objectives. This involves defining the scope of the work and expected outcome, at the same time detailing all the necessary objectives to get there. While you do all of these, you’ll need to keep tabs on company resources and allocate them effectively to finish projects within budget. From onset to completion of the project, you’ll represent our clients, helping them organise and analyse tender and procurement for all contractors and suppliers.
   

  

 Building strong teams and business reputation
   

  

 One of your main concerns will be to produce high\-performing teams that drive successful project execution. You’ll need to collaborate effectively with a range of stakeholders, leading from the front while also taking the time to understand their point of view. You’ll also represent and promote the company throughout projects, and seize additional opportunities along the road.
   

  

 Core to our reputation is our strong focus on health \& safety and on sustainability, and you’ll be expected to keep these front\-of\-mind at all times.
   

  

**Sound like you?**
 Our successful Project Managers …
   

  

* Engage confidently with internal and external stakeholders and see things from their perspective.
* Are driven to succeed and love achieving challenging goals.
* Bring a structured and organised approach to everything they do.
* Communicate and collaborate to achieve success.
* Thrive under pressure and deal effectively with tight deadlines and high expectations.


**To apply you need to be:**
 Client\-centric problem solver
   

  

 We employ talent from a wide range of backgrounds, though typically you should have a degree in a relevant field, and/or around five years’ experience in design, construction, project management in interior fit\-out projects for multinational clients. It would be excellent if you have a strong background in all aspects of interior fit\-out management—including management on schedule, quality, cost and risk management, and negotiation, to name a few. Your expertise in surveying a client’s basic needs, completing commercial assessments, and preparing PM proposals will also be put to the test. Your quickness in understanding and dealing with a situation will be indispensable especially in carrying out value engineering, build ability analysis, critical reviews of design and documentation.
   

  

 Business savvy and action\-oriented
   

  

 To excel in this role, you should have a high level of understanding and technical expertise in business. We deliver projects that help our clients succeed as well as help JLL achieve our business and financial goals.
   

  

 Are you well versed in project products, systems, processes, tools and best practices? Can you handle the site operations no matter how complex it may be?
   

  

 Likewise, you should have a great sense of urgency when it comes to solving problems, improving products or services, finding new markets, and implementing new strategies. You are resilient and can deal effectively with competing priorities and tight deadlines. You should know how to negotiate to generate risk\-assessed solutions, and how to handle ambiguities.
   

  

 A great communicator with superb organisational skills
   

  

 Do you have what it takes to lead and motivate your project team members? Are you capable of leading by example and fostering a creative environment? We achieve our biggest success when working together, so clear communication is key, as is collaboration and team work.
   

  

 A structured and organised approach with an eye for detail is also crucial, as is being tech\-savvy. As the digital leader in project management, we use a range of technology platforms to deliver our projects.

 Job Description: Conversion SME (Manager)
   

  

**Position Title:** 
 Manager – Conversion Subject Matter Expert (Life Insurance \& Annuities Policy Administration Transformation)
   

  

**Function:** 
 Insurance
   

  

**Location:** 
 Bangalore / Chennai / Coimbatore / Kochi / Kolkata / Noida /Hyderabad / Pune / Trivandrum
   

  

 Role Summary
   

  

 The Conversion SME will own the end\-to\-end data and policy conversion strategy for a Life \& Annuities policy administration system transformation (e.g., legacy platform to FAST/Majesco/OIPA/FINEOS target). This role bridges business, actuarial, and technical teams to ensure accurate, compliant, and auditable migration of in\-force policy data, values, and transaction history from source to target systems.
   

  

 Key Roles \& Responsibilities
   

  

**Conversion Strategy \& Governance**
* Define the end\-to\-end conversion approach: crosswalk methodology, data mapping standards, tolerance thresholds, and reconciliation framework between legacy and target platforms.
* Own the conversion playbook — cutover strategy (big\-bang vs. phased/wave\-based), fallback/rollback plans, and freeze\-period governance.
* Establish data lineage documentation and version\-controlled mapping specs for audit and regulatory traceability.


**Business \& Technical Bridge**
* Translate legacy policy administration rules (billing, values, riders, beneficiaries, agent/commission structures) into target system configuration requirements.
* Partner with actuarial, IT, and QA teams to validate converted policy values (cash value, reserves, death benefit, surrender values) against source\-of\-truth calculations.
* Lead root\-cause analysis on conversion breaks/exceptions and drive remediation with configuration or ETL teams.


**Data Mapping \& Rules Definition**
* Author functional specifications for field\-level, transaction\-level, and history conversion (policy, billing, claims\-in\-progress, agent/commission, correspondence).
* Define exception handling rules for non\-standard policies, riders, or legacy product variants that don't map cleanly to the target chart of accounts/product model.
* Validate mapping specs with source system SMEs and target platform configuration leads.


**Testing \& Reconciliation**
* Design and oversee conversion test cycles (mock conversions, parallel runs, dress rehearsals) and define pass/fail acceptance criteria.
* Own policy\-level and aggregate\-level reconciliation reporting (financial tie\-outs, record counts, value tolerances) presented to governance/steering forums.
* Sign off on conversion readiness gates ahead of each cutover wave.


**Team \& Stakeholder Management**
* Lead and mentor a pod of conversion analysts/testers (onshore/offshore); manage workload, quality, and delivery timelines.
* Act as primary conversion point of contact for client business owners, actuarial, compliance, and IT conversion teams.
* Present conversion status, risk, and exception dashboards to steering committee/PMO.


**Compliance \& Risk**
* Ensure conversion approach aligns with regulatory requirements (state filings, policyholder notification rules, NAIC/IFRS 17 where applicable).
* Maintain audit trail documentation sufficient for internal audit and regulatory examination.


 Must\-Have Skills
   

  

**Category**
**Requirement**
**Domain**
 9
   

  

**Platform**
 Hands\-on conversion experience on at least one target PAS: FAST, Majesco, OIPA, FINEOS, or equivalent legacy modernization platform
   

  

**Conversion\-specific**
 Prior experience in at least one full PAS conversion/migration cycle — mapping, mock conversions, parallel testing, cutover
   

  

**Data**
 Strong SQL skills; experience with data mapping/ETL concepts; policy value reconciliation (cash value, reserves, COI, fund values for annuities)
   

  

**Documentation**
 Ability to write field\-level functional specs, mapping documents, and test scripts to consulting\-grade standards
   

  

**Delivery**
 Experience managing a pod, sprint/wave\-based delivery, and reporting into a governance/PMO structure
   

  

**Regulatory**
 Familiarity with state insurance regulations, policyholder notification requirements, and IFRS 17/statutory reporting impacts on conversion
   

  

**Preferred Skills**
* Prior Big 4/IT Service Company or systems integrator consulting background
* Experience with both Life and Annuities product lines (not just one)
* Exposure to agile delivery frameworks (Scrum/SAFe) in a conversion pod context
* Group Benefits conversion exposure (cross\-domain flexibility)
* Vendor\-side experience (e.g., having worked at a FAST/Majesco/FINEOS implementation partner)


**Credentials/Certifications (Preferred, Not Mandatory)**
* LOMA certifications relevant to conversion/operations
* CSPO® / PMP® / Prosci (change management) for delivery\-side credibility
* Platform\-specific certifications (FAST, Majesco, FINEOS) where available


**EY \| Building a better working world**

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

The candidate will be responsible for complete project execution from planning and mobilization through erection, installation, commissioning, trial run and final handover to the client.

Key Responsibilities

Overall responsibility for end\-to\-end execution of boiler and associated industrial projects.

Plan, execute and monitor projects from project kick\-off to successful commissioning and handover.

Handle projects involving 1 TPH to 100 TPH boilers, including large\-capacity and complex industrial installations.

Lead and coordinate boiler erection, installation, piping, equipment erection, testing and commissioning activities.

Review project drawings, technical specifications, BOQ, project schedules and execution plans.

Prepare detailed project execution plans, manpower plans, material requirements and site schedules.

Coordinate with Design, Production, Purchase, Quality, Service, Stores and Accounts teams for smooth project execution.

Act as the primary point of contact for clients, consultants, contractors and project stakeholders.

Monitor project progress against approved timelines, budgets and quality requirements.

Identify project risks, delays and technical issues and take timely corrective actions.

Manage site manpower, contractors, subcontractors, vendors and other resources effectively.

Ensure availability of materials, equipment, tools and manpower as per project requirements.

Monitor project costs and ensure execution within approved budget.

Conduct regular project review meetings and submit progress reports to management.

Ensure compliance with approved quality, safety and statutory requirements at project sites.

title: Site Supervisor
description:
**Company Description** 
 Garuda Design Studio is a collaborative practice of designers, architects, engineers, and project managers dedicated to creating thoughtful, functional living spaces. The studio focuses on vernacular contemporary design, blending local character with modern comfort and usability. Projects emphasize purity in design, natural materials, and a strong connection to the surrounding environment. Team members work closely together to deliver spaces that feel cozy, livable, and intentionally crafted. The culture supports creativity, technical excellence, and a commitment to sustainable, people\-centered design.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Site Supervisor is a full\-time, on\-site role based in the Kolkata metropolitan area, responsible for overseeing day\-to\-day activities at project sites. This position coordinates with designers, architects, engineers, contractors, and vendors to ensure that work is executed according to drawings, specifications, and safety standards. Daily responsibilities include monitoring site progress, managing manpower and resources, maintaining quality control, and documenting work through reports, photographs, and checklists. The Site Supervisor also handles basic issue resolution on site, escalates technical concerns to the design and engineering teams, and supports adherence to timelines and budgets. The role involves regular site inspections, communication with clients or client representatives, and ensuring compliance with local regulations and company procedures.
   

**Qualifications**
* Ability to supervise construction sites, including monitoring daily activities, coordinating trades, and ensuring adherence to design and technical specifications.
* Strong skills in site planning and organization, including scheduling, resource allocation, and basic project coordination with internal teams and external vendors.
* Working knowledge of construction methods, materials, and finishes relevant to residential and vernacular contemporary designs, with attention to quality and safety.
* Competence in documenting site work through reports, measurements, photographs, and checklists, and maintaining accurate records for project tracking.
* Effective interpersonal and communication skills for collaborating with architects, engineers, contractors, and clients, and for resolving routine on\-site issues.
* Ability to interpret architectural and engineering drawings, and translate plans into clear instructions for site teams.
* Understanding of basic health, safety, and environmental standards applicable to construction sites in the Kolkata metropolitan area.
* Relevant experience as a Site Supervisor or similar role in architecture, interior design, or construction projects; residential or small\-scale projects experience is advantageous.
* Diploma or degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, or a related field is preferred; equivalent hands\-on experience may be considered.
* Willingness to work primarily on site, travel between project locations within the metropolitan area, and adapt to changing project demands.

 Managing corporate interior programs involving multiple locations, phased implementations, or integrated workplace transformations is expected. Managing critical issues through rapid problem\-solving, stakeholder coordination, and effective decision\-making is necessary.  Supporting proposal development and client pitches for new corporate interior opportunities across Gujarat is expected. Providing technical inputs, methodology frameworks, and project approach strategies for competitive bids will contribute to win rates. Participating in client meetings, site visits, and presentations during business development cycles demonstrates thought leadership. Representing JLL at industry forums, client events, and networking opportunities to build brand visibility and market presence supports business growth.
   

  

**Innovation \& Best Practices**
 Staying current with emerging trends in workplace design, flexible workspaces, activity\-based working, and workplace technology is essential. Introducing innovative project delivery methods, digital tools, and process improvements to enhance efficiency and client value is valued. Sharing knowledge, lessons learned, and best practices across the PDS team to drive continuous improvement demonstrates leadership. Contributing to development of standard operating procedures, project templates, and knowledge management systems builds organizational capability.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
**Education \& Experience**
 Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Interior Design, or Construction Management is required; Master's degree in Project Management, Construction Management, or MBA is preferred. A minimum of 12\-16 years of progressive experience in project management with at least 8 years focused on corporate interiors, commercial fitouts, or office projects is essential. Demonstrated track record of successfully delivering 20\+ corporate interior projects with values ranging from ₹5 crores to ₹50\+ crores is mandatory. Minimum 4\-5 years in leadership roles managing project teams and multiple concurrent projects is required. Experience working with Fortune 500 companies, multinational corporations, or large Indian conglomerates is highly valued.
   

  

**Technical Competencies**
 Comprehensive knowledge of interior construction systems, materials, finishes, furniture systems, and specialty installations is required. Expert understanding of MEP systems coordination, raised flooring, modular partitions, suspended ceilings, and integrated technology solutions is necessary. Thorough knowledge of NBC, state building regulations, fire safety codes, accessibility standards, and sustainability frameworks (LEED, IGBC, WELL) is mandatory. Proficiency in project management software including Primavera P6 or MS Project for scheduling, along with advanced skills in MS Office Suite for reporting and presentations is expected. Familiarity with AutoCAD or Revit for reviewing drawings and BIM coordination is advantageous.
   

  

**Commercial \& Financial Skills**
 Strong commercial acumen with proven ability to manage project budgets ranging from ₹5 crores to ₹50\+ crores successfully is essential. Experience in contract negotiation, procurement strategy, and vendor management is required. Understanding of construction contracts including FIDIC, JCT, or standard Indian contract formats is necessary. Ability to conduct value engineering, cost\-benefit analysis, and financial scenario modeling is valued. Experience with budget forecasting, cash flow management, and financial reporting to clients and management is expected.
   

  

**Leadership \& Management Capabilities**
 Proven leadership experience managing teams of 5\-15 professionals across multiple projects simultaneously is required. Strong mentoring and coaching abilities with track record of developing high\-performing teams is essential. Strategic thinking capability with ability to balance operational excellence with business development objectives is necessary. Executive presence and ability to engage confidently with C\-suite stakeholders and senior client representatives is fundamental. Change management skills to drive adoption of new processes, tools, or methodologies across teams is valued.
   

  

**Communication \& Interpersonal Skills**
 Exceptional communication and presentation skills in English and Hindi (Gujarati is highly advantageous) with ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non\-technical audiences is required. Strong negotiation and conflict resolution capabilities to manage contractor disputes, client concerns, and stakeholder disagreements is essential. Relationship\-building skills with ability to establish trust and credibility with diverse stakeholders including clients, consultants, contractors, and internal teams is necessary. Diplomatic approach to managing sensitive issues while maintaining professional relationships and project momentum is valued.
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
 PMP (Project Management Professional) certification from PMI demonstrates project management excellence. LEED AP or IGBC AP certification indicates sustainability expertise relevant to corporate interiors. Experience with design\-build, EPC, or integrated project delivery methods is valuable. Exposure to workplace strategy consulting, change management, or organizational development enhances strategic value. Knowledge of Agile project management or Lean Construction principles demonstrates innovation mindset. Prior experience with JLL or international project management consultancies provides cultural alignment.
   

  

**Key Performance Indicators**
 Project delivery success measured by on\-time, on\-budget completion with quality standards met across portfolio. Client satisfaction scores averaging 4\.5\+/5\.0 with strong Net Promoter Scores and testimonials. Financial performance including revenue targets, profit margins, and collection efficiency metrics. Business development contribution through successful conversions, account expansion, and referral generation. Team development measured by retention rates, skill progression, and promotion readiness of direct reports. Risk management effectiveness demonstrated by minimal claims, disputes, or quality issues across projects.
   

  

**Work Environment \& Expectations**
 This role is based in Gujarat (Ahmedabad/Gandhinagar) with regular travel across Gujarat and occasional travel to other Indian cities as project demands require. Hybrid work arrangement with significant time spent at project sites for inspections, meetings, and stakeholder coordination. Client\-facing role requiring flexibility to attend meetings, site visits, and presentations according to client schedules. Extended working hours during critical project phases, milestone deadlines, or client emergencies may be necessary. Professional office environment when not on site, with collaborative workspace and access to modern technology tools.
   

  

**What We Offer**

 Opportunity to lead prestigious corporate interior projects for India's leading corporations and multinationals with high visibility and impact. Clear career progression path to Associate Director, Director, and senior leadership roles within JLL PDS practice. Access to JLL's global learning platform with technical training, leadership development programs, and professional certifications. Exposure to international best practices through JLL's global network and knowledge\-sharing platforms. Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, life insurance, and wellness programs. Professional development allowance for certifications, training, and industry conferences.  Collaborative, inclusive work environment that values diversity, innovation, and professional excellence. title: Fabrication Engineer
description:
Fabrication Engineer
 
  





**Location:** 
 Ahmedabad, Gujarat
 



**Department:** 
 Fabrication / Production
 



**Experience:** 
 5–8 Years
 



**Industry Preference:** 
 Heavy Engineering / Industrial Machinery / Construction Equipment / Structural Fabrication
 



  




 About the Company
 
**Macons** 
 is an established Indian manufacturer of construction and infrastructure equipment, with a strong focus on
 **concrete batching plants, concrete mixers, concrete block making machines, concrete pumps, and other specialized construction machinery** 
 .
 



 With decades of experience in the industry, Macons is committed to delivering
 **reliable, robust, and technologically advanced equipment** 
 that helps contractors and infrastructure companies improve productivity and efficiency.
 



 At Macons, we believe in
 **engineering excellence, continuous improvement, and building long\-term relationships with our customers** 
 .
 



  




 About the Role
 
 We are looking for an experienced
 **Fabrication Engineer** 
 to join our manufacturing team in Ahmedabad. The candidate will be responsible for managing and supervising day\-to\-day fabrication activities for heavy machinery components, ensuring that production is completed safely, efficiently, and as per approved drawings and quality standards.
 



 The ideal candidate should have strong
 **hands\-on shop\-floor experience in MS fabrication, welding, fit\-up, cutting, drilling, bending, and dimensional inspection** 
 , along with the ability to manage manpower and achieve production targets.
 



  




 Key Responsibilities
 * Plan, supervise, and monitor daily fabrication activities on the shop floor.
* Manage fabrication of machine structures, frames, hoppers, platforms, brackets, tanks, and other fabricated components.
* Read and interpret
 **fabrication drawings, assembly drawings, BOMs, and welding details** 
 .
* Plan fabrication sequences to improve productivity and minimize rework.
* Supervise
 **cutting, bending, fit\-up, welding, grinding, drilling, and finishing** 
 operations.
* Coordinate with welders, fitters, fabricators, helpers, and other shop\-floor personnel.
* Allocate manpower and machines according to production priorities.
* Monitor daily production against planned targets and take corrective action when required.
* Ensure fabricated components meet required
 **dimensions, tolerances, alignment, and welding quality** 
 .
* Identify fabrication defects such as distortion, weld defects, dimensional mismatch, improper fit\-up, and excessive rework.
* Coordinate with the
 **Design, Production, Quality, Stores, and Assembly departments** 
 for smooth workflow.
* Ensure availability of required raw materials, consumables, drawings, tools, and fixtures before starting fabrication.
* Monitor material utilization and minimize wastage.
* Implement proper fabrication sequences and welding procedures to control distortion.
* Conduct in\-process inspections and coordinate with the Quality team for final inspection.
* Maintain fabrication\-related production records and daily progress reports.
* Identify bottlenecks in fabrication and implement practical solutions to improve productivity.
* Ensure adherence to workplace safety procedures and proper use of PPE.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives related to
 **productivity, quality, cost, and delivery** 
 .



  




 Required Skills \& Qualifications
 * Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in
 **Mechanical Engineering** 
 or related discipline.
* **5–8 years of relevant experience in fabrication** 
 , preferably in heavy engineering or machinery manufacturing.
* Strong practical knowledge of
 **MS fabrication and welding processes** 
 .
* Good understanding of
 **MIG/MAG, ARC welding and gas cutting** 
 .
* Ability to read and understand mechanical and fabrication drawings.
* Knowledge of fabrication tolerances, fit\-up, alignment, welding sequence, and distortion control.
* Experience in handling and supervising shop\-floor manpower.
* Good knowledge of fabrication tools, machinery, fixtures, and measuring instruments.
* Ability to identify fabrication and welding defects.
* Strong problem\-solving and production\-planning skills.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Proficiency in
 **MS Excel and basic production reporting** 
 .



  




 Preferred Experience
 
 Candidates with experience in any of the following industries will be preferred:
 


* Heavy Machinery Manufacturing
* Construction Equipment
* Concrete Machinery
* Crane Manufacturing
* Material Handling Equipment
* Industrial Equipment
* Structural Steel Fabrication
* Heavy Engineering
* EPC / Industrial Fabrication



  




 What We Are Looking For
 
 We are looking for someone who is
 **strong on the shop floor** 
 , understands fabrication practically, and can independently manage fabrication activities from
 **raw material to ready\-for\-assembly components** 
 .
 



 Candidates whose experience is primarily limited to CAD/design work and who do not have hands\-on fabrication or shop\-floor supervision experience may not be suitable for this position.
 



  




 Why Join Us?
 * Opportunity to work on
 **large industrial machinery and heavy engineering projects**
* **Hands\-on exposure to complete machinery manufacturing**
* **Opportunity to work closely with Design, Production, Quality, and Assembly teams**
* **Growth opportunity within the manufacturing organization**
* **Job Type:** 
 Full\-time
* **Location:** 
 Ahmedabad, Gujarat

description:
**PROJECT DIRECTOR – HERITAGE DESTINATION DEVELOPMENT \& IMPLEMENTATION** 




**Move On Heritage Planner \| Thrissur, Kerala** 




**About Move On Heritage Planner** 




 Move On Heritage Planner is a new venture of Move on Leisure and Travels (India) Pvt. Ltd., a professionally managed Travel Management Company based in Thrissur, Kerala, serving travellers since 2008\. The venture aims to preserve and activate Kerala’s living heritage by developing selected Illams, Manas, Tharavads, ancestral homes and other heritage properties as distinctive destinations for weddings, cultural programmes, corporate events, photography, heritage dining and immersive experiences—creating sustainable value for property owners and local communities.
 



**About the Role** 




 We are looking for an accomplished Project Director to lead the end\-to\-end development and implementation of Move On Heritage Planner. The Project Director will translate the approved project vision and business model into a professionally managed heritage destination network, balancing conservation, commercial viability, destination development and community participation.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




 ·        Lead project planning, implementation, milestones, budgets and performance monitoring.
 



 ·        Identify, assess and onboard suitable heritage properties in coordination with owners and technical experts.
 



 ·        Coordinate conservation, restoration, architectural, structural, environmental and heritage requirements.
 



 ·        Develop approved properties into professionally managed event and experience destinations while protecting their heritage character.
 



 ·        Oversee destination weddings, corporate events, cultural programmes, photography/film shoots, heritage dining and community events.
 



 ·        Drive marketing, sales, partnerships and business development with tourism, wedding, MICE, event and creative\-industry partners.
 



 ·        Manage relationships with property owners, government/local bodies, professionals, vendors, communities, artisans and institutional partners.
 



 ·        Monitor financial performance, revenue models, property profitability and commercial sustainability.
 



 ·        Promote local employment, local sourcing and responsible heritage\-event practices.
 



 ·        Oversee project reporting, digital records, dashboards, KPIs, risk management and operational performance.
 



**Candidate Profile** 




 ·        Graduate/Postgraduate in Architecture, Heritage Conservation, Civil Engineering, Tourism, Hospitality, Event Management, Business/Project Management, Development, Cultural Management, Economics or a related field.
 



 ·        10–15 years of relevant professional experience, preferably with 5\+ years in senior management or project leadership.
 



 ·        Demonstrated experience in at least two relevant areas: heritage/conservation, tourism destination development, hospitality/property management, event management, infrastructure/project implementation or business development.
 



 ·        Strong leadership, strategic planning, commercial understanding, stakeholder management, negotiation and multidisciplinary team\-management skills.
 



 ·        Knowledge of Kerala’s traditional architecture, cultural heritage and responsible destination development will be an advantage.
 



**What the Project Director Will Lead** 




 ·        Heritage \& Architecture
 



 ·        Property Development \& Management
 



 ·        Events \& Venue Operations
 



 ·        Marketing, Sales \& Business Development
 



 ·        Heritage Experiences, Culinary \& Cultural Programmes
 



**Success Measures** 




 Success will be measured through property onboarding, conservation implementation, venue activation, events and revenue, sales conversion, strategic partnerships, customer experience, local economic participation, sustainability and expansion from pilot properties to a Kerala\-wide network.
 



**Engagement Opportunity** 




 The position may be structured as a full\-time Executive/Project Director or, where appropriate, as a stakeholder/strategic partner with executive responsibility. The final arrangement will define authority, remuneration/returns, responsibilities and performance expectations.
 



**Official Designation** 




 PROJECT DIRECTOR – HERITAGE DESTINATION DEVELOPMENT \& IMPLEMENTATION
 



**Employment or Stakeholder\-Based Engagement Model** 




 The position of Project Director may be structured flexibly according to the ownership, investment and management requirements of Move on Heritage Event Planner. The Project Director may serve either as a full\-time employee/director of the company or as a stakeholder/strategic partner with an agreed ownership or investment interest, subject to the company’s legal structure and governing documents.
 



**Option A – Project Director as Employee / Executive Director** 




 ·        The Project Director may be appointed as a full\-time employee or Executive Director of the company.
 



 ·        The person shall receive agreed salary/remuneration and may be eligible for performance\-based incentives.
 



 ·        The Project Director shall exercise the responsibilities and delegated authority specified in this role description.
 



 ·        The appointment, remuneration, reporting relationship and delegated financial/operational powers shall be documented through an employment or service agreement.
 



**Option B – Project Director as Stakeholder / Strategic Partner** 




 ·        The Project Director may participate in the company as a stakeholder, shareholder, promoter, investor or strategic partner, subject to the applicable legal structure.
 



 ·        The role may combine project leadership with strategic, financial, business\-development or network\-building responsibilities.
 



 ·        Remuneration may be structured through agreed professional fees, profit share, incentives, dividends or other legally permissible arrangements.
 



 ·        The stakeholder arrangement should clearly define ownership, decision\-making rights, responsibilities, performance expectations, conflict\-of\-interest provisions and exit/transfer arrangements.
 



**Option C – Stakeholder with Executive Responsibility** 




 Where a stakeholder is appointed to lead implementation, the person may function as an Executive Project Director with day\-to\-day operational responsibility. The stakeholder’s ownership interest does not replace the need for clearly defined project targets, reporting requirements, delegated authority and accountability for results.
 



**Recommended Provision** 




 The company may retain the flexibility to appoint the Project Director either from within its professional management team or from among strategic stakeholders/investors, depending on the stage of the project and the expertise, investment capacity and leadership contribution required. In either arrangement, the Project Director shall remain accountable for the approved implementation plan and agreed Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).

title: Incident & Change Management Coordinator
description:
Dodge Construction Network (Dodge) is looking for a detail\-oriented, process\-driven professional to build out and mature our Incident Management and Change Management functions. These functions currently exist but lack formal structure\-this role will own the transformation from ad hoc handling to a disciplined, auditable, well\-governed practice. You'll design and implement the processes, approval workflows, and reporting that give engineering, IT, and leadership confidence that incidents are resolved consistently and changes are reviewed, approved, and tracked before they hit production. This is a hands\-on process\-and\-tooling role, not just a policy\-writing one. You'll be expected to build the actual workflows, forms, and automations inside our Atlassian ecosystem (Jira, Confluence, and related apps) that make the new processes stick.
   

  

 This is a full\-time position and reports directly to the VP, IT Infrastructure and Operations.
   

  

***Preferred Location***
 Qualified candidates should be based in or near Kochi and able to work from our Kochi office as part of a hybrid schedule.
   

  

**Essential Functions**
**Incident Management**
* Formalize incident management processes: severity classification, escalation paths, communication protocols, and resolution SLAs
* Own the incident lifecycle in Jira Service Management (or Jira), from detection/logging through resolution and closure
* Drive post\-incident reviews (blameless retrospectives / RCAs), ensure action items are tracked and closed, and report on recurring themes
* Build dashboards and recurring reports on incident volume, MTTR, severity trends, and SLA compliance for leadership visibility


**Change Management**
* Design and implement a formal Change Management process, including change categorization (standard/normal/emergency), risk assessment, and CAB (Change Advisory Board) review cadence
* Build structured Jira workflows and forms to capture change requests, required approvals, rollback plans, and post\-implementation review
* Partner with engineering, infrastructure, and application teams (AWS, M365, Atlassian, and internal platforms) to ensure changes are properly vetted before deployment
* Track change success/failure rates and use data to continuously refine the process


**Tooling, Automation \& Governance**
* Configure and maintain Jira workflows, schemes, automation rules, and Jira Service Management request forms to support both processes end\-to\-end
* Use Atlassian automation (Jira Automation, Confluence integrations, forms) to reduce manual steps\-auto\-routing, approval reminders, SLA breach alerts, ticket linking, etc.
* Maintain Confluence documentation: runbooks, process guides, RACI charts, and CAB meeting notes
* Establish approval workflows and audit trails that satisfy internal governance and any relevant compliance requirements
* Identify opportunities to integrate Incident/Change data with other systems (e.g., monitoring/alerting tools, CMDB\-type asset tracking) as the practice matures


**Cross\-Functional Coordination**
* Act as the process owner and point of contact across engineering, infrastructure, and vendor/contractor teams for all things incident and change related
* Facilitate CAB meetings and post\-incident reviews, keeping them efficient and action\-oriented
* Train and onboard teams on new processes, driving adoption without becoming a bottleneck


***Education Requirement***
 Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent education and work experience.
   

  

**Required Experience, Knowledge And Skills**
* 3\+ years of experience in Incident Management, Change Management, IT Service Management (ITSM), or a Project/Program Management role with process\-ownership responsibility
* Hands\-on experience administering Atlassian products\-Jira and/or Jira Service Management required; Confluence experience strongly preferred
* Demonstrated experience building Jira workflows, automation rules, and forms (Jira Service Management request forms or similar) \- this is not just "used Jira," but "configured Jira."
* Strong understanding of ITIL\-aligned incident and change management concepts (formal ITIL certification is a plus, not required)
* Excellent organizational skills with the ability to build structure from ambiguity\-you'll be creating a lot of this from scratch
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; comfortable facilitating meetings with technical and non\-technical stakeholders, including leadership
* Data\-oriented mindset\-comfortable building reports/dashboards to show process health and drive continuous improvement
* Experience working in a technical environment (cloud infrastructure, SaaS, or software engineering organization) is a strong plus, even if you're not an engineer yourself


**Preferred Experience, Knowledge And Skills**
* ITIL v3/v4 Foundation certification
* Experience with Jira Service Management's Change and Incident\-specific templates/features
* Familiarity with AWS or Microsoft 365 environments (you won't need to administer them but understanding what a "change" looks like in these environments helps)
* Experience supporting SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar compliance frameworks where change/incident records are auditable evidence


**About Dodge Construction Network**
 Dodge Construction Network exists to deliver the comprehensive data and connections the construction industry needs to build thriving communities. Our legacy is deeply rooted in empowering our customers with transformative insights, igniting their journey towards unparalleled business expansion and success. We serve decision\-makers who seek reliable growth and who value relationships built on trust and quality. By combining our proprietary data with cutting\-edge software, we deliver to our customers the essential intelligence needed to excel within their respective landscapes. We propel the construction industry forward by transforming data into tangible guidance, driving unparalleled advancement.
   

  

 Dodge is the catalyst for modern construction.

* Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related technical field is preferred.
